The following is completed based on the README content: first a project summary, then a usage tutorial for beginners. All commands and parameters are taken solely from the README.

I. Project Summary#

What it is. gadget is a collection of practical tools accumulated by the author during daily development, covering five directions: AI chat daily report generation, paper discovery and researcher analysis, CPU/GPU performance benchmarking, Hugo blog automation, and document translation. Each tool is located in an independent directory under tools/ and can be used separately. Common capabilities (LLM calls, JSON parsing fixes, disk caching, atomic writes, local translation engine, Hugo deployment) are unified in the common/ package in the repository root, installed via pip install -e .. The development workflow engine and all Claude Code skills are not in this repository, but in a sibling independent repository ai-companion, accessed through hooks under .claude/ and .codex/. The project uses the GPL-3 license.

Repository Structure.

Directory / File Function
tools/summarize/ AI chat daily / weekly / monthly reports
tools/research/ Paper discovery + researcher analysis + citation graphs
tools/benchmark/ CPU/GPU performance benchmarking
tools/website/ Hugo blog (incremental media compression + automatic build and release)
tools/translator/ Gradio document translator
common/ Shared infrastructure package relied upon by all tools
scripts/ Ops scripts: sync.py, onboard.py, smoke.sh, serve_local_llm.sh, language.py, profile_translation.py
docs/ Design documents, ECL plan (docs/ecl/), audit reports, historical archives (docs/archive/)
outputs/ All generated artifacts (gitignored, can be rebuilt automatically), subdivided into logs / reports / cache / data / images / backups
tokens/ API keys and onboarding forms, gitignored, must NEVER be committed
AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md AI agent working protocols and Claude Code repository guide
pyproject.toml Packaging configuration
config.json Tool settings (gitignored, copied from config.example.json), paths can be overridden by GADGET_CONFIG

What each tool does.

  • Summarize: Reads chat logs from Claude Code / Codex / Cursor Agent / ChatGPT / general JSON, and calls LLMs to generate structured daily, weekly, and monthly reports. It uses a multi-device two-stage architecture: each device first exports logs, which are then aggregated via cloud drive synchronization or manual copying before being merged to generate the report. Through the source-specific commands of ccusage 20.x (ccusage claude, ccusage codex, ccusage gemini), it automatically statistics token usage and costs for each agent CLI.
  • Research: A unified entry point via tools/research/research_scout.py providing four types of capabilities. Paper discovery: searches arXiv / bioRxiv / PubMed, and uses a three-stage LLM pipeline (“quick screening → deep evaluation → citation impact”) to generate research weekly reports and deploy them to Hugo, supporting conference paper and author searches. Deep insight (--insight): downloads full texts to analyze writing structures and publication strategies, automatically matching OpenReview reviews. Researcher profiling: combines arXiv + Semantic Scholar data to generate research trajectory analysis and tier scores, automatically discovering mentor-student relationships, and supporting name disambiguation and reverse lookup. Citation graphs: performs forward citation / backward reference analysis based on the Semantic Scholar API.
  • Benchmark: Cross-platform CPU/GPU FLOPS testing, supporting NVIDIA CUDA, Apple MPS, and Intel XPU (OpenCL only appears in --info detection), covering FP64 / FP32 / FP16 / BF16 / FP8 (experimental). It employs a warm-up + formal measurement + statistical analysis (median, IQR for outlier removal) approach, with explicit GPU synchronization to ensure timing accuracy. Results are written to CSV in append mode, and it can generate Plotly interactive HTML reports and leaderboards, supporting deployment to Hugo and submission to public leaderboards.
  • Website: The Hugo static blog “TzJ’s Net” (PaperMod theme), deployed to GitHub Pages. It features built-in incremental media compression (only processes files changed after .last_build, using pngquant for images and HandBrakeCLI for videos) and local model Chinese-English bilingual translation (defaults to Ollama, falls back to vLLM on Linux, transformers on Windows; models in tencent/Hy-MT2-1.8B are automatically downloaded on first run). Automatically generated content is written directly to tools/website/content|static with gadget_generated tags; handwritten files will not be overwritten. tools/website/public/ is an independent deployment repository, automatically committed and pushed by build scripts; do not commit directly to it.
  • Translator: A Gradio web translator based on the common translation engine, providing a local interface similar to Google Translate. It supports text and .md / .txt / .pdf / .docx / image files, protecting Markdown snippets like code blocks, URLs, and Hugo shortcodes during translation. The entire process uses local inference, automatically selecting the backend (ollama / transformers / vllm / llamacpp) via common.engine.create_engine(). Models remain in memory, with lazy loading upon model switching. The source language can be set to auto (detected by CJK ratio), and when the target is auto, it flips between Chinese and English.

Four LLM Backends. All LLM functions are switched uniformly via --api: ollama (default, local Ollama, no key required, Qwen3.8-27B), claude_cli (reuses Claude Code CLI login state, no API key required), anthropic, and openai. The environment variable GADGET_LLM_BACKEND can also be used for global settings.

II. Usage Tutorial#

1. Environment Preparation

  • Python 3.10 or above, recommended to use conda environment AI.
  • Node.js 18 or above, only required for the ../ai-companion/ independent repository.
  • For specific dependencies of each tool, see requirements.txt in the corresponding directory.
  • Website building requires Hugo, pngquant, and HandBrakeCLI.
  • Cross-device synchronization requires configuring rclone.
  • The default LLM backend is local Ollama; if you do not want to install Ollama, you can use --api claude_cli to reuse the Claude Code login state, or use anthropic / openai and place API keys in the tokens/ directory.
conda activate AI

2. Installation

Execute in the repository root. all contains the common package and dependencies for the four tools: summarize / research / benchmark / website, but does not include translator, which must be installed separately.

pip install -e ".[all]"
pip install -e ".[translator]"

When only a single tool is needed, you can also install just the base package or a single extra:

pip install -e .
pip install -e ".[website]"

Installation will generate build/ and gadget.egg-info/ in the repository root; these are gitignored and should not be committed.

3. Configuration

  • Copy config.example.json to config.json and modify as needed. config.json is gitignored. When paths need to be changed, set the environment variable GADGET_CONFIG.
  • sync.py reads the sync section of config.json; persistent settings for serve_local_llm.sh are placed in the summarize section.
  • API keys are placed in the tokens/ directory and must NEVER be committed.
  • Global environment variables: GADGET_LLM_BACKEND sets the LLM backend; GADGET_TRANSLATION_BACKEND sets the translation engine (ollama → llamacpp / vllm / transformers); GADGET_TRANSLATION_MODEL overrides the translation model.For one-time configuration of a new machine, you can follow the onboarding process: fill in tokens/onboard.yaml, and run scripts/onboard.py once; the script will automatically complete SSH configuration, Claude/Codex CLI installation and authentication, pip extras and ai-companion installation, tool configurations, and rclone bootstrap.
python scripts/onboard.py

After installation, you can run a read-only smoke test to check if all tools’ --help / --info / import are working normally, without triggering LLM, network, or write operations:

bash scripts/smoke.sh

4. Summarize: Daily / Weekly / Monthly Reports

The typical workflow is divided into two stages. First, export unexported dates on each device, then sync and merge them day by day on the aggregation device. Once enough daily reports are accumulated, weekly and monthly reports are generated, and --deploy will be deployed to Hugo together.

python -m summarize daily export
python -m summarize daily merge --sync-all
python -m summarize weekly generate --week 2026-W12 --deploy
python -m summarize monthly generate --month 2026-02 --deploy
python -m summarize auto --deploy

auto is a one-click full process: Export → Merge → Weekly Report → Monthly Report + Deployment. To switch LLM backends, add --api, for example --api claude_cli. Old entries python tools/summarize/daily_summary.py ..., weekly_summary.py, and monthly_summary.py are still available, but the new format is recommended.

If you want to create a specially tuned local Ollama variant for summarize and export environment variables:

eval "$(bash scripts/serve_local_llm.sh env)"

5. Research: Paper Discovery and Researcher Analysis

The unified entry point is tools/research/research_scout.py, run from the repository root.

python tools/research/research_scout.py report --project my-project
python tools/research/research_scout.py ask "找 Pieter Abbeel 最近的机器人操作论文"
python tools/research/research_scout.py profile "Sergey Levine"
python tools/research/research_scout.py citations 2301.12597
python tools/research/research_scout.py deploy
  • report --project: A complete pipeline: Search → Three-stage evaluation → Report generation.
  • ask: Natural language search with automatic data source routing.
  • profile: Researcher profiling.
  • citations: Citation graph generation by arXiv ID or DOI.
  • deploy: Deploy reports to Hugo.
  • For deep paper insights, add the --insight parameter. All LLM features support switching backends via --api.

6. Benchmark: Performance Benchmarking

All commands must first enter the tools/benchmark/ directory. Results are appended to a CSV and will not overwrite old results; multiple runs on multiple hardware will naturally accumulate into a leaderboard.

cd tools/benchmark
python -m benchmark.cli
python -m benchmark.cli --cpu-only
python -m benchmark.cli --gpu-only
python -m benchmark.cli --report
python -m benchmark.cli --report --deploy
  • Without parameters: Run all tests.
  • --cpu-only / --gpu-only: Test only CPU or GPU.
  • --report : Run tests and generate an HTML report.
  • --report --deploy : Generate reports and publish to the /benchmark/ page on Hugo.
  • --info : Detect hardware information. GPUs will automatically recognize CUDA / Apple MPS / Intel XPU.

7. Website: Hugo Blog

First, install website extra (which includes torch + transformers required for translation), then run the build script. The script performs incremental compression, translation, and Hugo building, and automatically commits and pushes to the tools/website/public/ deployment repository.

pip install -e ".[website]"
cd tools/website && bash update.sh

For Windows, use the PowerShell script, which will automatically switch to its own directory:

powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tools/website/update.ps1

Local preview (development server, including drafts):

cd tools/website && hugo server -D

Notes: The first run will automatically download the translation model tencent/Hy-MT2-1.8B. Hand-written articles should be placed directly in tools/website/content]; files without the gadget_generated tag will not be automatically overwritten. Do not commit directly to tools/website/public/], and do not git add the deployment repository or the theme repository.

8. Translator: Document Translator

pip install -e ".[translator]"
python -m translator

After starting, a Gradio interface will open in your browser, allowing you to translate text or upload .md / .txt / .pdf / .docx / images. The default model is tencent/Hy-MT2-1.8B (GGUF variant tencent/Hy-MT2-1.8B-GGUF)), which will be automatically downloaded upon first use. To change models, set GADGET_TRANSLATION_MODEL or operate within the model management in the interface. Backend selection rules: if a model tag is already pulled, ollama is prioritized; on Windows, it falls back to transformers; on Linux, vllm is prioritized; if VRAM is insufficient, llamacpp is used to load GGUF.

9. Cross-device Data Synchronization

sync.py uses rclone to centrally synchronize data categories such as summarize / website / research / benchmark / backups, supporting push / pull / status / bootstrap / config operations. There is also a special dag category used for generating and deploying DAG sites.

python scripts/sync.py
python scripts/sync.py push
python scripts/sync.py pull

10. Other Scripts and ai-companion

  • scripts/language.py: Hugo bilingual auditing and summarize report renaming.
  • scripts/profile_translation.py: Translation engine GPU performance analysis.
  • ai-companion is an independent Node.js repository that needs to be cloned to ../ai-companion/. It provides code change tracking, a /idea → /ccplan → /ccedit planning and execution pipeline, and all skills; see ../ai-companion/scripts/install.ts for installation instructions.
  • A system-level one-click installation script for Ubuntu 22.04/24.04 servers is also available in that repository:
bash ../ai-companion/scripts/onboard-server.sh --help

In it, --companion-repo directly passes the ai-companion repository address git@github.com:TzJ2006/ai-companion.git, and --companion-ref is no longer required.

11. Output Locations and Submission Norms

All generated products are under outputs/: logs/ intermediate products, reports/ final reports, cache/ LLM and search cache, data/ structured data, images/ charts, and backups/ forced overwrite backups. Hugo content is written directly to tools/website/content|static, with no separate staging directory. Never git add automatically generated content, rclone synchronized data, build/, gadget.egg-info/, or any files under tokens/.

If you need to publish this tutorial as a shareable webpage, just let me know.

│   ├── summarize/      # AI 对话日报 / 周报 / 月报
│   ├── research/       # 论文发现 + 研究者分析 + 引用图谱
│   ├── benchmark/      # CPU/GPU 性能基准测试
│   ├── website/        # Hugo 博客(增量媒体压缩 + 自动构建发布)
│   └── translator/     # Gradio 文档翻译器
├── common/             # 共享基础设施包(LLM / 缓存 / IO / 翻译 / Hugo)—— 所有工具依赖它
├── scripts/            # 运维 + 维护脚本(sync.py, onboard.py, language.py, profile_translation.py, …)
├── docs/               # 设计文档、ECL 计划(docs/ecl/)、审计报告、历史归档(docs/archive/)
├── outputs/            # 所有生成产物(gitignored,可自动重建)
├── AGENTS.md           # 所有 AI agent 的工作流协议(行动前先读)
├── CLAUDE.md           # 给 Claude Code 的仓库指南
└── pyproject.toml      # common/ 与各工具的打包配置(pip install -e .)

build/ and gadget.egg-info/ are generated by pip install -e . (gitignored, always located at the repository root).

Where to go to make changes:

What you want to do Where to go
Change the logic of a specific tool tools/<tool>/
Change shared capabilities (LLM / Cache / Translation / Hugo deployment) common/
Change data synchronization scripts/sync.py
One-time configuration of a new machine scripts/onboard.py
Change development workflow / skill ai-companion repository (sibling ../ai-companion/)
Read plans / design documents docs/ecl/, docs/

What each tool does#

tools/summarize/ —— AI Conversation Daily / Weekly / Monthly Reports#

Automatically reads daily AI conversation logs (Claude Code / Codex / Cursor Agent / ChatGPT / general JSON) and calls LLM APIs to generate structured daily, weekly, and monthly reports. Multi-device workflow: each device exports conversation logs → sync via cloud drive or manual copy to an aggregation device → generate final daily reports; once enough daily reports are accumulated, weekly and monthly trend summaries are generated. Automatically discovers and statistics token usage and costs for all agent CLIs through the ccusage 20.x namespace-by-source command (ccusage claude, ccusage codex, ccusage gemini…). Four types of AI summary backends, unified via --api for switching. Key technologies: Claude/OpenAI API, ccusage 20.x (multi-source unification), matplotlib.

tools/research/ —— Paper Discovery and Researcher Analysis#

A unified academic research toolbox providing four major capabilities through a single CLI entry point tools/research/research_scout.py:

  • Paper Discovery: Search for papers from arXiv / bioRxiv / PubMed, following a three-stage LLM pipeline (fast screening → deep evaluation → citation impact), generating research weekly reports and deploying them to Hugo. Supports conference paper search and author search.
  • Deep Paper Insights (--insight): Download full papers and let the LLM analyze their writing structure, publication strategy, and reusable core knowledge; automatically match OpenReview to obtain peer reviews and analyze consensus and controversy; synthesize cross-paper research writing guides.
  • Researcher Profiling: Scrape paper and citation data from ArXiv + Semantic Scholar, use LLM to generate research trajectory analysis, calculate tier scores, and automatically discover mentor-student relationships through homepage extraction + co-authorship patterns. Supports name disambiguation and reverse lookup.
  • Citation Graph Analysis: Forward citation / backward reference analysis based on the Semantic Scholar API, combined with LLM-driven impact interpretation.

tools/benchmark/ —— Performance Benchmarking SuiteCross-platform CPU/GPU FLOPS benchmarking tool, measuring floating-point performance uniformly across different hardware vendors and precision levels. Supports actual GPU execution for NVIDIA(CUDA), Apple Silicon(MPS), and Intel(XPU) (OpenCL may only appear in --info detection), covering precisions such as FP64 / FP32 / FP16 / BF16 / FP8(experimental). Measurement uses Warm-up + Formal Measurement + Statistical Analysis (median, IQR outlier removal), and explicitly performs GPU synchronization to ensure timing accuracy. Results are accumulated in CSV in append mode (never overwrites, naturally supports multi-hardware cumulative leaderboards), can generate interactive HTML reports and leaderboards with Plotly charts, and supports deployment to Hugo websites and submission to public leaderboards.#

tools/website/ —— Hugo Blog#

Hugo static blog site (“TzJ’s Net”, PaperMod theme), deployed to GitHub Pages (https://tzj2006.github.io/). Built-in incremental image/video compression pipeline (only compresses media changed since .last_build: images via pngquant, videos via HandBrakeCLI) and local model bilingual translation (default Ollama, with vLLM on Linux / transformers on Windows as fallback; model tencent/Hy-MT2-1.8B is automatically downloaded upon first run, without using cloud LLM APIs). Auto-generated content (daily/weekly/monthly reports, research reports, benchmark pages, images) is written directly to tools/website/content|static by the deployment pipeline (the unique Hugo content root, files marked with gadget_generated; hand-written files without marks are never overwritten), then translated, compressed, built, and pushed.

⚠️ tools/website/public/ is a standalone deployment repository (tzj2006/tzj2006.github.io), automatically committed + pushed by build scripts —— do not commit directly to it.

tools/translator/ —— Gradio Document Translator#

A Gradio document translator based on the common translation engine: a local translation web interface in the style of Google Translate, translating text and files (.md / .txt / .pdf / .docx / images), while preserving Markdown formatting (code blocks, URLs, Hugo shortcodes, etc., are protected). It runs local inference rather than cloud APIs: reuses common.engine.create_engine() to automatically select the backend (automatically prioritizes ollama if the model tag is already pulled; transformers is the Windows fallback, prioritizing vllm on Linux, and llamacpp is the low-VRAM GGUF option), with models staying in memory (warm) and lazily loaded on demand when switching models. Default model is tencent/Hy-MT2-1.8B (GGUF variant tencent/Hy-MT2-1.8B-GGUF), automatically downloaded upon first use, and can be overridden via GADGET_TRANSLATION_MODEL or the model management within the GUI. Source language can be set to auto (detected by CJK text ratio); when the target language is auto, it flips between zh↔en.

common/ —— Shared Infrastructure Package#

The shared layer that all tools depend on, installed as a Python package via pip install -e .:

  • LLM calls (unified two-layer API, supporting four backends: ollama(default) / claude_cli / anthropic / openai))
  • JSON parsing and repair
  • SHA-256 disk cache (namespace + TTL)
  • Atomic writes and content hashing
  • Local inference translation engine (Ollama / vLLM / transformers / GGUF) and bilingual content generation
  • Cross-platform Hugo deployment

scripts/ —— Ops and Maintenance Scripts#

  • sync.py —— Centralized rclone data synchronization (push / pull / status / bootstrap / config, covering summarize / website / research / benchmark / backups categories; there is also a special dag category for generating + deploying DAG sites). Configured in the sync section of the repository root config.json (paths can be overridden via GADGET_CONFIG).
  • onboard.py —— Repository-level one-time machine initialization: fill out a YAML table (tokens/onboard.yaml), run the script once, and it automatically completes SSH configuration, Claude/Codex CLI installation and authentication, pip extras and ai-companion installation, tool configurations, and rclone bootstrap.
  • smoke.sh —— Read-only smoke check covering all tools (--help / --info / import; does not involve LLM, network, or writing).
  • serve_local_llm.sh —— Creates an Ollama variant optimized for summarize and prints environment variables. Persistence switches are located in the summarize section of the repository root config.json.
  • Others: language.py (Hugo bilingual audit + summarize report renaming), profile_translation.py (translation engine GPU profiler).

../ai-companion/ —— Independent Repository#

An independent Node.js repository, checked out in the sibling directory ../ai-companion/, not within this repository. It records function-level code changes, generates tests and HTML reports, provides a /idea→/ccplan→/ccedit plan-execute pipeline, and hosts all Claude Code skills (methodologies + domains). This repository connects via hooks under .claude/ and .codex/.

It is packaged both as a standard Claude Code plugin and an equivalent Codex integration —— ready to use upon installation without building (the change tracking hook is a pre-built single-file product committed with the repository). All skills (Methodologies: ccplan planning, optimize optimization, cchypothesis debugging, repo-audit auditing, repo-tidy tidying; Domains: summarize code overview, slurm-gpu cluster detection, nature-benchmark / NIPS-2025-paper paper writing advisor) are in that repository; this repository no longer contains the skills/ directory. See ../ai-companion/scripts/install.ts for installation.

outputs/ —— Output Directory#

All generated outputs are unified in outputs/ (already gitignored, can be automatically rebuilt):

outputs/
├── logs/         # 中间产物(导出日志、运行日志)
├── reports/      # 最终报告(Markdown、JSON、HTML)
├── cache/        # LLM 缓存、搜索缓存
├── data/         # 结构化数据(CSV、JSON profiles)
├── images/       # 图表和生成的图片
└── backups/      # 强制覆盖备份(website-force 等)

Hugo site content is written directly to tools/website/content|static (no independent outputs/site staging tree).

II. Usage Tutorial (For First-time Users)#

This tutorial only covers what is written in the README. For step-by-step operations, configuration, data formats, and FAQs for each tool, please further consult the TUTORIAL.md in the repository and each tool’s own original documentation.

Step 0: Environment Preparation#

  • Python 3.10+ (conda environment AI is recommended)
  • Node.js 18+ (only required by the independent repository ../ai-companion/)
  • Specific dependencies for each tool can be found in the corresponding directory’s requirements.txt
  • website / translation functions use a local inference engine (default Ollama; vLLM on Linux, transformers on Windows as fallback), and model tencent/Hy-MT2-1.8B is automatically downloaded upon first run.

Activate the recommended environment:

conda activate AI

Step 1: Installation#

Install the common package + extras for summarize / research / benchmark / website:

pip install -e ".[all]"

⚠️ Note: all does not include translator, which must be installed separately:

pip install -e ".[translator]"

If you only want to use a specific tool, you can also install only the corresponding extra:

pip install -e ".[website]"      # website(含 torch + transformers 用于翻译)
pip install -e ".[translator]"   # translator(gradio + GGUF 翻译栈)

After installation, build/ and gadget.egg-info/ will be generated in the repository root (already gitignored, which is normal).

Step 2: Configuration#

Tool Configuration Files: config.json at the repository root (already gitignored), copied from config.example.json:

cp config.example.json config.json

To use different paths, set environment variables to override:

export GADGET_CONFIG=/path/to/your/config.json

Among them, the sync section is for scripts/sync.py configuration, and the summarize section is for the scripts/serve_local_llm.sh persistence switch.

API Keys: Placed in the tokens/ directory (already gitignored, never commit its contents).

LLM Backend Selection: All LLM functions use the --api parameter for switching, with four possible values:

Value Description
ollama Default, local Ollama, no key required, Qwen3.8-27B
claude_cli Reuses the login status of Claude Code CLI, no API key needed
anthropic Anthropic API
openai OpenAI API

You can also set it globally using environment variables:

export GADGET_LLM_BACKEND=ollama

Translation Backend: Translation uses the local inference engine, selected by GADGET_TRANSLATION_BACKEND: ollama(default when the model is already pulled, uses local Ollama server) → llamacpp / vllm / transformers (in-process), with model tencent/Hy-MT2-1.8B. The translation model can be overridden:

export GADGET_TRANSLATION_BACKEND=ollama
export GADGET_TRANSLATION_MODEL=tencent/Hy-MT2-1.8B

Step 3 (Optional): One-time Initialization for New Machines#

After filling out the tokens/onboard.yaml YAML table, run:

python scripts/onboard.py

It will automatically complete SSH configuration, Claude/Codex CLI installation and authentication, pip extras and ai-companion installation, tool configurations, and rclone bootstrap.

Server System-level Installation (Ubuntu 22.04/24.04, one-click installation of SSH public keys, Claude Code, Codex, Superpowers, Ponytail, and AI Companion) has been migrated to the ai-companion repository:```bash bash ../ai-companion/scripts/onboard-server.sh –help


After the repository split, `--companion-repo` is directly passed to the ai-companion repository (`git@github.com:TzJ2006/ai-companion.git`), and `--companion-ref` is no longer needed.

## Step 4: Run a smoke test first

Read-only, no LLM/network/writing, used to confirm installation:

```bash
bash scripts/smoke.sh

Tool 1: Summarize —— AI Chat Daily/Weekly/Monthly Reports#

The python -m summarize format is recommended. The typical workflow is two-stage: export on each device first, then aggregate and merge.

python -m summarize daily export                                   # 阶段 1:导出所有尚未导出的日期
python -m summarize daily merge --sync-all                         # 阶段 2:同步所有日期并逐日合并
python -m summarize weekly generate --week 2026-W12 --deploy       # 周报 + 部署
python -m summarize monthly generate --month 2026-02 --deploy      # 月报 + 部署
python -m summarize auto --deploy                                  # 一键全流程:导出 → 合并 → 周报 → 月报 + 部署

Multi-device usage: Run daily export on each device, aggregate the logs together via cloud drive synchronization or manual copying, then run daily merge --sync-all to generate the final daily report; once enough daily reports have accumulated, generate weekly and monthly trend summaries.

Switching AI summary backend:

python -m summarize auto --deploy --api claude_cli

If you want to use the summarize tuning variant with local Ollama:

eval "$(bash scripts/serve_local_llm.sh env)"

Old entries python tools/summarize/daily_summary.py ... / weekly_summary.py / monthly_summary.py are still available (backward-compatible re-export shim), but the new format above is recommended.

See TUTORIAL.md#summarize and tools/summarize/tutorial.md for details.

Tool 2: Research —— Paper Discovery and Researcher Analysis#

Single CLI entry tools/research/research_scout.py:

python tools/research/research_scout.py report --project my-project        # 全流程:搜索 → 三阶段评估 → 报告
python tools/research/research_scout.py ask "找 Pieter Abbeel 最近的机器人操作论文"  # 自然语言搜索(自动路由数据源)
python tools/research/research_scout.py profile "Sergey Levine"             # 研究者画像
python tools/research/research_scout.py citations 2301.12597               # 引用图谱(按 arXiv ID / DOI)
python tools/research/research_scout.py deploy                              # 把报告部署到 Hugo

Use --insight for deep insights; all LLM functions support switching backends via --api, for example:

python tools/research/research_scout.py report --project my-project --api claude_cli

See TUTORIAL.md#research and tools/research/TUTORIAL.md for details.

Tool 3: Benchmark —— Performance Benchmarking#

⚠️ All commands require first cd into tools/benchmark/.

cd tools/benchmark
python -m benchmark.cli                    # 跑全部基准测试(结果追加到 CSV)
python -m benchmark.cli --cpu-only         # 只跑 CPU
python -m benchmark.cli --gpu-only         # 只跑 GPU
python -m benchmark.cli --report           # 跑测试 + 生成 HTML 报告
python -m benchmark.cli --report --deploy  # 生成报告 + 发布到 Hugo /benchmark/

To only view hardware detection results without actually running, use --info (note that OpenCL may only appear in --info detection and does not mean it can actually run). GPU benchmarks will automatically detect CUDA / Apple MPS / Intel XPU. Results are accumulated in append mode and will not overwrite history, so they can be run on multiple machines and accumulated into a leaderboard.

See TUTORIAL.md#benchmark and tools/benchmark/tutorial.md for details.

Tool 4: Website —— Hugo Blog#

pip install -e ".[website]"                          # 安装依赖(含 torch + transformers 用于翻译)
cd tools/website && bash update.sh                   # macOS/Linux:增量压缩 + Hugo 构建 + 推送 Pages
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tools/website/update.ps1  # Windows(脚本会自己 cd 到所在目录)
cd tools/website && hugo server -D                   # 本地预览(dev server,包含草稿)

Bilingual auditing and summarize report renaming:

python scripts/language.py

Two red lines you must remember:

  1. tools/website/public/ is an independent deployment repository, which is automatically committed and pushed by build scripts —— do not commit directly to it.
  2. Automatically generated files carry the gadget_generated tag; handwritten files without the tag will never be overwritten —— so handwritten content is safe, but do not add that tag to handwritten files.

See TUTORIAL.md#website and tools/website/CLAUDE.md for details.

Tool 5: Translator —— Gradio Document Translator#

pip install -e ".[translator]"   # 安装依赖(gradio + GGUF 翻译栈)
python -m translator             # 启动 Gradio GUI(在浏览器中打开)

After starting, you can translate text in the web page, or upload .md / .txt / .pdf / .docx / image files. Selecting auto as the source language will automatically detect based on the text CJK ratio; selecting auto as the target language will flip between Chinese and English. You can change models in the model management within the GUI, or set environment variables before starting:

export GADGET_TRANSLATION_MODEL=tencent/Hy-MT2-1.8B-GGUF
python -m translator

Models are automatically downloaded upon first use, with full local inference, without using cloud APIs.

For UI wiring see tools/translator/app.py, for translation and file logic see tools/translator/core.py, and for the shared engine see common/engine.py and common/translation.py. See TUTORIAL.md#translator for details.

Cross-device Data Synchronization#

python scripts/sync.py           # 查看用法
python scripts/sync.py push      # 推送
python scripts/sync.py pull      # 拉取

Subcommands include push / pull / status / bootstrap / config, covering categories summarize / website / research / benchmark / backups, with a special dag category used for generating + deploying DAG sites. You need to configure rclone first; configuration is in the sync section of config.json.

Common Precautions (Must Comply)#

  • tokens/ stores API keys and onboarding tables, which are gitignored —— never commit its contents.
  • All generated file outputs go to outputs/, which is gitignored.
  • Never git add: automatically generated content, rclone synchronized data, build artifacts (build/, gadget.egg-info/), and the deployment and theme repositories under tools/website/.
  • Read AGENTS.md (workflow protocols for all AI agents) before taking action.
  • This project is licensed under GPL-3 (see LICENSE).

Project Summary#

Gadget is a collection of practical tools accumulated during daily development, covering five major categories: AI chat daily report generation, paper discovery, performance benchmarking, blog automation, and document translation.

Repository Structure#

gadget/
├── tools/              # 五个独立工具产品
│   ├── summarize/      # AI 对话日/周/月报

The development workflow engine and all Claude Code skills are located in the independent repository ai-companion (in the same directory ../ai-companion/ ), connected to this repository through hooks under .claude/ and .codex/.

What Each Tool Does#

Tool Function Key Technologies
summarize Reads daily AI chat records (Claude Code / Codex / Cursor Agent / ChatGPT / general JSON), calls LLM to generate structured daily/weekly/monthly reports; uses ccusage 20.x to statistics token usage and costs for each Agent CLI Claude/OpenAI API, ccusage 20.x, matplotlib
research Provides paper discovery (arXiv/bioRxiv/PubMed three-stage LLM pipeline), deep paper interpretation (--insight, including OpenReview review matching), researcher profiling (including teacher-student relationship mining), and citation graph analysis via a unified CLI (research_scout.py) arXiv/bioRxiv/PubMed, Semantic Scholar, LLM
benchmark Cross-platform CPU/GPU FLOPS evaluation, supporting NVIDIA/Apple Silicon/Intel, multiple precisions (FP64~FP8), results accumulated as CSV, can generate HTML reports and deploy to Hugo PyTorch, NumPy, Plotly
website Hugo static blog (PaperMod theme), built-in incremental image/video compression (pngquant/HandBrakeCLI) and local model bilingual translation, automatic content writing to `tools/website/content static`
translator Gradio web translator based on the common translation engine, supporting text and files (.md/.txt/.pdf/.docx/images), preserving Markdown format, local inference Gradio, GGUF/transformers

All LLM functions switch backends uniformly through --api: ollama (default, local without keys), claude_cli (reusing Claude Code login state), anthropic, openai.

# Gadget Project Complete Guide

## I. Project Summary

### 1.1 Project Overview

**Gadget** is an open-source toolset that gathers practical tools accumulated during daily development. It covers the following functions:
- **AI Daily Report Generation** — Automatically statistics AI conversation records from multiple devices to generate daily/weekly/monthly reports.
- **Paper Discovery** — Searches and evaluates papers from academic databases, analyzing researchers and citation networks.
- **Performance Benchmarking** — Cross-platform FLOPS testing for CPU/GPU.
- **Blog Automation** — Hugo static site, supporting incremental media compression and automatic deployment.
- **Document Translation** — A Gradio translator with local inference, supporting text and various file formats.

### 1.2 Repository Structure

gadget/ ├── tools/ # 5个独立工具产品 │ ├── summarize/ # AI对话日/周/月报告 │ ├── research/ # 论文发现 + 研究者分析 + 引文图 │ ├── benchmark/ # CPU/GPU性能基准测试 │ ├── website/ # Hugo博客（增量压缩 + 自动发布） │ └── translator/ # Gradio文档翻译器 ├── common/ # 共享基础设施包（所有工具依赖） ├── scripts/ # 运维脚本（数据同步、机器配置等） ├── docs/ # 设计文档和ECL计划 ├── outputs/ # 生成的文件（自动重建，已gitignore） ├── CLAUDE.md # Claude Code 仓库指南 └── pyproject.toml # Python打包配置


### 1.3 Functions of Each Tool

| Tool | Function | Core Features |
|------|------|---------|
| **Summarize** | AI conversation daily/weekly/monthly reports | Multi-device aggregation, multi-source token statistics, switchable between 4 LLM backends |
| **Research** | Paper discovery + Researcher analysis | arXiv/bioRxiv/PubMed search, three-stage evaluation, citation graphs, research trajectory analysis |
| **Benchmark** | CPU/GPU performance testing | Supports CUDA/MPS/XPU, multiple precisions (FP64-FP8), HTML reports + Plotly charts |
| **Website** | Hugo blog | Incremental image/video compression, automatic publishing to GitHub Pages, local bilingual translation |
| **Translator** | Document translator | Local inference, supports MD/TXT/PDF/DOCX/images, preserves formatting |

### 1.4 Infrastructure

- **common/** — Shared capabilities such as LLM calls, disk cache, translation engine, Hugo deployment, etc.
- **scripts/** — Data synchronization (`sync.py`), machine initialization (`onboard.py`), LLM services (`serve_local_llm.sh`), etc.
- **ai-companion/** — A separate Node.js repository (located in `../ai-companion/`), providing code change tracking and all Claude Code skills.

---

## II. Detailed Usage Tutorial

### 2.1 Environment Preparation

#### System Requirements

- **Python 3.10+** (conda environment recommended)
- **Node.js 18+** (only required for the ai-companion repository)
- Git

#### Creating Python Environment

```bash
# 使用conda创建Python 3.10环境
conda create -n AI python=3.10
conda activate AI

# 或者使用venv
python3.10 -m venv venv
source venv/bin/activate  # Linux/macOS
# 或在Windows上: venv\Scripts\activate

2.2 Installation Steps#

Step 1: Clone the Repository#

git clone <gadget-repository-url>
cd gadget

Step 2: Install Common Packages and All Tools#

# 安装common包 + summarize/research/benchmark/website的所有依赖
pip install -e ".[all]"

# 如果需要translator工具，需单独安装
pip install -e ".[translator]"

# 如果需要website工具的完整功能（包含torch+transformers用于翻译）
pip install -e ".[website]"

Step 3: Prepare API Keys and Configuration#

# 创建token目录（存放API密钥等敏感信息，已gitignore）
mkdir -p tokens/

# 从示例配置创建主配置文件
cp config.example.json config.json

# 编辑config.json，填入以下信息：
# - LLM API密钥（如果使用anthropic或openai后端）
# - Hugo部署配置（如果使用website工具）
# - rclone数据同步配置（如果需要跨设备数据同步）

Step 4: One-time Machine Initialization (Optional but Recommended)#

If it is a new machine, you can use the automation script to complete all configurations at once:

# 编辑初始化配置表
# 打开 tokens/onboard.yaml，填入SSH/API密钥/工具配置等

# 运行初始化脚本
python scripts/onboard.py

# 这个脚本会自动完成：
# - SSH配置
# - Claude Code / Codex CLI 登录
# - pip 依赖安装
# - 各工具配置
# - rclone 引导启动

Step 5: Verify Installation#

# 运行烟雾测试（只读，无LLM调用，无网络，无写入）
bash scripts/smoke.sh

2.3 Tool Configuration#

Global LLM Backend Configuration#

All tools switch backends via the unified --api parameter:

# 方式1：命令行指定
python -m summarize daily export --api ollama

# 方式2：环境变量全局设置
export GADGET_LLM_BACKEND=claude_cli
python -m summarize daily export  # 自动使用claude_cli

# 可用后端
# - ollama（默认，本地Ollama，无需密钥，模型：Qwen3.8-27B）
# - claude_cli（重用Claude Code CLI登录状态，无需API密钥）
# - anthropic（需要ANTHROPIC_API_KEY环境变量）
# - openai（需要OPENAI_API_KEY环境变量）

Translation Engine Configuration#

The translation used by Website and Translator tools uses local inference:

# 方式1：自动选择（推荐）
# - Ollama已安装且模型已拉取 → 使用ollama
# - Linux → vllm优先
# - Windows → transformers优先

# 方式2：指定后端
export GADGET_TRANSLATION_BACKEND=transformers

# 方式3：指定模型
export GADGET_TRANSLATION_MODEL=tencent/Hy-MT2-1.8B-GGUF

# 默认模型会在首次使用时自动下载

Ollama Local LLM Service (Recommended)#

# 启动Ollama服务并输出环境变量
eval "$(bash scripts/serve_local_llm.sh env)"

# 这会：
# 1. 拉取并启动 Qwen 模型（如果未启动）
# 2. 输出环境变量供后续命令使用
# 3. 持久化配置保存在repo根目录 config.json 的 summarize 字段

2.4 Detailed Usage for Each Tool#

2.4.1 Summarize — AI Conversation Daily/Weekly/Monthly Reports#

Function: Automatically extracts token usage and conversation content from multi-device AI conversation records to generate structured daily, weekly, and monthly reports.

Workflow:

  1. Export unexported conversation records on each device (Phase 1)
  2. Aggregate via cloud drive synchronization or manual copying (Phase 2)
  3. Generate daily, weekly, and monthly reports

Typical Commands:

# === Phase 1: 导出所有未导出日期的对话记录 ===
python -m summarize daily export

# === Phase 2: 同步所有日期并逐日合并 ===
python -m summarize daily merge --sync-all

# === 生成周报（周号格式：2026-W12，表示2026年第12周）===
python -m summarize weekly generate --week 2026-W12

# 生成周报并自动发布到Hugo博客
python -m summarize weekly generate --week 2026-W12 --deploy

# === 生成月报（月份格式：2026-02）===
python -m summarize monthly generate --month 2026-02

# 生成月报并发布
python -m summarize monthly generate --month 2026-02 --deploy

# === 一键完整流程 ===
# 导出 → 合并 → 生成周报 → 生成月报 + 自动发布
python -m summarize auto --deploy

# === 指定LLM后端 ===
python -m summarize daily export --api anthropic
python -m summarize auto --deploy --api openai

Supported LLM Backends:

  • ollama (default, local, no key required)
  • claude_cli (reuses Claude Code CLI)
  • anthropic (requires ANTHROPIC_API_KEY)
  • openai (requires OPENAI_API_KEY)

Detailed Step-by-Step Tutorial: See TUTORIAL.md — Summarize and tools/summarize/tutorial.md

2.4.2 Research — Paper Discovery and Researcher Analysis#

Function: A unified academic research toolkit providing paper discovery, in-depth paper analysis, researcher analysis, and citation graph analysis.

Entry Point: tools/research/research_scout.py

Typical Commands:

# === 论文发现完整流程 ===
# 搜索论文 → 三阶段评估（快速筛选→深度评估→引文影响）→ 生成周报 → 发布Hugo
python tools/research/research_scout.py report --project my-project

# === 自然语言搜索（自动路由源）===
python tools/research/research_scout.py ask "找 Pieter Abbeel 最近的机器人操作论文"

# === 研究者分析 ===
# 获取论文+引用数据，生成研究轨迹分析，计算分级分数
# 自动发现导师-学生关系
python tools/research/research_scout.py profile "Sergey Levine"

# === 引文图分析 ===
# 基于Semantic Scholar API的前向/后向引用分析
python tools/research/research_scout.py citations 2301.12597

# === 发布报告到Hugo ===
python tools/research/research_scout.py deploy

# === 指定LLM后端 ===
python tools/research/research_scout.py report --project my-project --api claude_cli
python tools/research/research_scout.py profile "Sergey Levine" --api anthropic

LLM Backend Options:

  • ollama (default)
  • claude_cli
  • anthropic
  • openai

Detailed Step-by-Step Tutorial: See TUTORIAL.md — Research and tools/research/TUTORIAL.md

2.4.3 Benchmark — Performance Benchmarking#

Function: Cross-platform CPU/GPU FLOPS benchmarking, supporting various hardware and precisions.

Prerequisites:

cd tools/benchmark  # 所有命令必须在此目录执行

Supported Hardware:

  • NVIDIA (CUDA)
  • Apple Silicon (MPS)
  • Intel (XPU)

Supported Precisions: FP64, FP32, FP16, BF16, FP8 (experimental)

Typical Commands:

cd tools/benchmark

# === 运行所有基准测试（结果追加到CSV） ===
python -m benchmark.cli

# === 仅CPU测试 ===
python -m benchmark.cli --cpu-only

# === 仅GPU测试 ===
python -m benchmark.cli --gpu-only

# === 运行测试 + 生成HTML报告 ===
# 生成Plotly交互式图表、排行榜
python -m benchmark.cli --report

# === 生成报告 + 发布到Hugo /benchmark/ 页面 ===
python -m benchmark.cli --report --deploy

# === 提交到公共排行榜（如需要） ===
# 见详细文档

Result Processing:

  • Results are accumulated into a CSV (append mode, never overwritten)
  • Supports generating interactive HTML reports (Plotly)
  • Supports publishing to Hugo website
  • Supports submitting to public leaderboards

Detailed Step-by-Step Tutorial: See TUTORIAL.md — Benchmark and tools/benchmark/tutorial.md

2.4.4 Website — Hugo Blog Automation#

Function: A Hugo static blog website, supporting incremental media compression and automated deployment.

Website Information:

  • Website Name: “TzJ’s Net”
  • Theme: PaperMod
  • Deployment: GitHub Pages (https://tzj2006.github.io/)

Features:

  • Incremental image/video compression (only compresses files modified after .last_build)
  • Local bilingual translation (default Ollama, Linux alternative vLLM, Windows alternative transformers)
  • Automatic translation, compression, build, and push

Prerequisite Dependencies:

# 安装website依赖（包含torch + transformers用于本地翻译）
pip install -e ".[website]"

Typical Commands:

# === macOS / Linux ===
cd tools/website
bash update.sh  # 增量压缩 + Hugo构建 + 推送GitHub Pages

# === Windows ===
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tools/website/update.ps1
# 脚本自动cd到自己的目录

# === 本地预览（dev server） ===
cd tools/website
hugo server -D  # -D 表示包含草稿，打开 http://localhost:1313

Handling Automatically Generated Content:

  • Daily/weekly/monthly reports, research reports, benchmark pages, charts, etc., are written directly to tools/website/content|static by the publishing process of each tool.
  • All automatically generated files are marked with a gadget_generated tag.
  • Hand-written files (without tags) are never overwritten.

Deployment Repository:

  • tools/website/public/ is a separate deployment repository (tzj2006/tzj2006.github.io).
  • Automatically committed and pushed by the build script.
  • Do not commit directly to this directory.

Detailed Step-by-Step Tutorial: See TUTORIAL.md — Website and tools/website/CLAUDE.md

2.4.5 Translator — Gradio Document Translator#

Function: A document translator with local inference, supporting text and various file formats.

Features:

  • Local translation web interface in the style of Google Translate
  • Supported formats: .md / .txt / .pdf / .docx / images
  • Preserves Markdown formatting (code blocks, URLs, Hugo shortcodes, etc., are protected)
  • Local inference, no cloud API calls

Prerequisite Dependencies:

pip install -e ".[translator]"

Starting the Application:

python -m translator
# 自动在浏览器打开 Gradio GUI

Configuration:

# 默认模型（自动在首次使用时下载）
# 模型：tencent/Hy-MT2-1.8B（GGUF变体：tencent/Hy-MT2-1.8B-GGUF）

# 方式1：环境变量指定模型
export GADGET_TRANSLATION_MODEL=tencent/Hy-MT2-1.8B-GGUF

# 方式2：在GUI中管理模型

# 方式3：环境变量指定后端
export GADGET_TRANSLATION_BACKEND=ollama

Functionality:

  • Source language can be set to auto (automatically detected via CJK ratio in text)
  • When the target language is auto, it automatically switches between Chinese ↔ English

Detailed Step-by-Step Tutorial: See TUTORIAL.md — Translator

Code Reference:

  • UI Configuration: tools/translator/app.py
  • Translation and File Logic: tools/translator/core.py
  • Shared Translation Engine: common/engine.py, common/translation.py

2.5 Cross-Device Data Synchronization#

Function: Centralized rclone data synchronization, supporting push/pull/status/bootstrap/configuration.```bash

查看帮助#

python scripts/sync.py

推送到远程#

python scripts/sync.py push

拉取从远程#

python scripts/sync.py pull

查看同步状态#

python scripts/sync.py status

初始化bootstrap（首次setup）#

python scripts/sync.py bootstrap

配置同步#

python scripts/sync.py config


**Configuration**:
- Saved in the `sync` field of the repo root `config.json`
- Override configuration path: `GADGET_CONFIG` environment variable
- Override scope: summarize / website / research / benchmark / backups / dag (DAG website generation + publishing)

---

### 2.6 Output Directory Structure

All generated files are stored in the `outputs/` directory (already gitignored, can be automatically rebuilt):

outputs/ ├── logs/ # 中间文件（导出日志、运行日志） ├── reports/ # 最终报告（Markdown、JSON、HTML） ├── cache/ # LLM缓存、搜索缓存 ├── data/ # 结构化数据（CSV、JSON研究者数据） ├── images/ # 图表和生成的图像 └── backups/ # 强制覆盖备份（website-force等）


Hugo website content is **written directly** to `tools/website/content|static` (no separate output hierarchical directories).

---

### 2.7 Common Tips and Notes

#### Environment Variables Quick Reference

```bash
# LLM后端选择
export GADGET_LLM_BACKEND=claude_cli

# 翻译后端选择
export GADGET_TRANSLATION_BACKEND=transformers

# 翻译模型选择
export GADGET_TRANSLATION_MODEL=tencent/Hy-MT2-1.8B-GGUF

# 配置文件路径（默认./config.json）
export GADGET_CONFIG=/path/to/custom/config.json

First-time Use Checklist#

  • Environment preparation (Python 3.10+, conda/venv)
  • Install dependencies (pip install -e ".[all]")
  • Create config.json (copy from config.example.json)
  • Prepare API keys (placed in config.json or environment variables)
  • Run smoke test (bash scripts/smoke.sh)
  • Select a tool to get started

Troubleshooting Common Issues#

# 测试特定工具的导入（无网络、无LLM）
python -c "import summarize; print('OK')"
python -c "import research; print('OK')"

# 查看当前配置
cat config.json

# 重置缓存（如遇cache问题）
rm -rf outputs/cache/

# 检查GPU（仅benchmark）
cd tools/benchmark && python -c "import torch; print(torch.cuda.is_available())"

2.8 AI Companion Integration (Optional)#

This project provides the following via the ai-companion repository (located at ../ai-companion/):

  • Code change tracking
  • Claude Code planning/execution skills
  • All domain skills (summarize, optimize, etc.)

No extra configuration is required; it is automatically integrated via hooks. For more in-depth information, see ../ai-companion/scripts/install.ts.

2.9 Quick Start Examples#

Scenario 1: Generate this week’s AI conversation weekly report#

# 激活环境
conda activate AI

# 启动本地Ollama（如未启动）
eval "$(bash scripts/serve_local_llm.sh env)"

# 导出所有记录并生成周报
python -m summarize daily export
python -m summarize daily merge --sync-all
python -m summarize weekly generate --week 2026-W35 --deploy

Scenario 2: Search for the latest machine learning papers#

conda activate AI
python tools/research/research_scout.py report --project ml-papers --api claude_cli

Scenario 3: Test GPU performance and generate a report#

conda activate AI
cd tools/benchmark
python -m benchmark.cli --report

Scenario 4: Start the local document translator#

conda activate AI
python -m translator
# 浏览器自动打开 http://localhost:7860

This tutorial covers all key steps to using Gadget from scratch. Depending on your specific needs, select the corresponding tool and use it according to the commands above. If you have any questions, please refer to the TUTORIAL.md and source documentation of each tool.

Gadget Project Summary and Usage Tutorial#

Part 1: Project Summary#

Project Introduction#

Gadget is an open-source toolset that gathers practical tools accumulated during daily development, covering the following functions:

  • AI conversation daily/weekly/monthly report generation
  • Academic paper discovery and researcher analysis
  • Performance benchmarking (CPU/GPU)
  • Technical blog automation (Hugo)
  • Document translation service

Repository Structure#

gadget/
├── tools/              # 5 个独立工具产品
│   ├── summarize/      # AI 对话日/周/月报告
│   ├── research/       # 论文发现 + 研究者分析 + 引用图
│   ├── benchmark/      # CPU/GPU 性能基准测试
│   ├── website/        # Hugo 博客（增量压缩+自动发布）
│   └── translator/     # Gradio 文档翻译器
├── common/             # 共享基础设施包（LLM/缓存/IO/翻译/Hugo）
├── scripts/            # 运维和维护脚本
├── docs/               # 设计文档和存档
├── outputs/            # 生成的所有产物（.gitignore）
├── AGENTS.md           # AI 代理工作流协议
└── CLAUDE.md           # Claude Code 仓库指南

Detailed Tool Functions#

Tool Function Key Technologies
summarize Automatically generates daily/weekly/monthly reports of AI conversations Claude/OpenAI API, multi-source token statistics, matplotlib
research Paper discovery, researcher analysis, citation graphs arXiv/bioRxiv/PubMed, Semantic Scholar, LLM
benchmark Cross-platform CPU/GPU FLOPS performance testing PyTorch, NumPy, Plotly
website Hugo technical blog (incremental media compression + auto-publishing) Hugo, pngquant, HandBrakeCLI
translator Gradio document translator Gradio, local inference (GGUF/transformers)
common Shared infrastructure package used by all tools Unified LLM interface, cache, translation engine, Hugo deployment
scripts Operations scripts (data synchronization, machine initialization, etc.) rclone, Python

Part 2: Detailed Usage Tutorial#

I. Environment Preparation#

1. System Requirements#

  • Python 3.10+ (Recommended to use conda environment AI: conda activate AI)
  • Node.js 18+ (Only for optional AI Companion tools)

2. Basic Installation#

# 克隆仓库
git clone <gadget-repo-url>
cd gadget

# 安装 common 包及所有工具依赖
pip install -e ".[all]"

# 如果需要翻译工具，单独安装
pip install -e ".[translator]"

3. Configuration Files#

  • Copy from config.example.json to config.json (in the repository root)
  • Place API keys in the tokens/ directory (already .gitignore, will not be committed)
  • Override configuration path: Set environment variable GADGET_CONFIG=/path/to/custom/config.json

4. Initial Machine Configuration (Optional but Recommended)#

If it is a new machine, use the one-click configuration script:

# 编辑机器初始化配置（YAML 格式）
vim tokens/onboard.yaml

# 运行初始化脚本：自动配置 SSH、Claude/Codex 认证、pip 依赖、rclone 等
python scripts/onboard.py

II. Summarize (AI Conversation Daily/Weekly/Monthly Reports)#

Function Description#

Automatically integrates conversation logs from multiple AI assistants (Claude Code, Codex, ChatGPT, etc.) to generate structured daily, weekly, and monthly reports, and statistics for token usage.

Workflow#

Two-phase process:

  1. Phase 1 (Export): Export conversation logs from various devices
  2. Phase 2 (Merge): Sync via cloud drive and merge by date

Typical Commands#

# Phase 1: 导出所有未导出日期的对话记录
python -m summarize daily export

# Phase 2: 同步所有日期并逐日合并
python -m summarize daily merge --sync-all

# 生成周报（指定周号）
python -m summarize weekly generate --week 2026-W12 --deploy

# 生成月报（指定月份）
python -m summarize monthly generate --month 2026-02 --deploy

# 一键完整流程：导出 → 合并 → 周报 → 月报 + 自动发布
python -m summarize auto --deploy

LLM Backend Switching#

By default, it uses local Ollama (no API key required), but you can also switch to cloud-based backends:

# 使用 Claude Code CLI（无需单独 API 密钥）
python -m summarize daily export --api claude_cli

# 使用 Anthropic API
python -m summarize daily export --api anthropic

# 使用 OpenAI API
python -m summarize daily export --api openai

Detailed Documentation#

  • Step-by-step tutorial: TUTORIAL.md#summarize
  • Tool source documentation: tools/summarize/tutorial.md

III. Research (Paper Discovery and Researcher Analysis)#

Function Description#

An academic research toolset providing four major functions:

  • Paper Discovery: Search arXiv/bioRxiv/PubMed papers (three-stage LLM filtering → deep evaluation → citation impact analysis)
  • Deep Paper Insights: Analyze writing structure, publication strategies, and reusable knowledge
  • Researcher Analysis: Generate research trajectory analysis, tiered scoring, and discover student-mentor relationships
  • Citation Graph Analysis: Forward/backward citation analysis and LLM interpretation

Typical Commands#

# 完整流程：搜索 → 三阶段评估 → 生成报告
python tools/research/research_scout.py report --project my-project

# 自然语言搜索（自动路由数据源）
python tools/research/research_scout.py ask "找 Pieter Abbeel 最近的机器人操作论文"

# 研究者分析（自动从 ArXiv + Semantic Scholar 获取数据）
python tools/research/research_scout.py profile "Sergey Levine"

# 引用图分析（按 arXiv ID 或 DOI）
python tools/research/research_scout.py citations 2301.12597

# 将所有报告部署到 Hugo 博客
python tools/research/research_scout.py deploy

LLM Backend Switching#

Same as the Summarize tool, supporting four backends:

# 使用 Claude CLI
python tools/research/research_scout.py report --project my-project --api claude_cli

# 使用 Anthropic API
python tools/research/research_scout.py report --project my-project --api anthropic

Detailed Documentation#

  • Step-by-step tutorial: TUTORIAL.md#research
  • Tool source documentation: tools/research/TUTORIAL.md

IV. Benchmark (CPU/GPU Performance Testing)#

Function Description#

A cross-platform FLOPS benchmarking tool supporting:

  • GPU: NVIDIA (CUDA), Apple Silicon (MPS), Intel (XPU)
  • Precision: FP64, FP32, FP16, BF16, FP8 (experimental)
  • Statistics: Warm-up + formal measurement + median/IQR outlier removal
  • Output: Append to CSV (supports multi-hardware leaderboards) + interactive HTML reports + Hugo deployment

Typical Commands#

# 进入工具目录（所有命令都需要）
cd tools/benchmark

# 运行所有基准测试（结果追加到 CSV）
python -m benchmark.cli

# 仅测试 CPU
python -m benchmark.cli --cpu-only

# 仅测试 GPU
python -m benchmark.cli --gpu-only

# 运行测试 + 生成 HTML 报告
python -m benchmark.cli --report

# 运行测试 + 生成报告 + 发布到 Hugo 的 /benchmark/ 目录
python -m benchmark.cli --report --deploy

Detailed Documentation#

  • Step-by-step tutorial: TUTORIAL.md#benchmark
  • Tool source documentation: tools/benchmark/tutorial.md

V. Website (Hugo Technical Blog)#

Function Description#

A Hugo static blog site featuring:

  • Automatic Content Generation: Directly writes blog content from summarize/research/benchmark tools
  • Incremental Media Compression: Since the last build, only compresses changed images (pngquant) and videos (HandBrakeCLI)
  • Local Translation: Uses Ollama (default) or vLLM/transformers for bilingual translation with no cloud calls
  • Automatic Publishing: Automatically pushes to GitHub Pages after building

Installation and Running#

# 安装网站工具的依赖（包括 torch 和 transformers）
pip install -e ".[website]"

# macOS/Linux: 增量压缩 + Hugo 构建 + GitHub Pages 推送
cd tools/website && bash update.sh

# Windows: 使用 PowerShell 脚本
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tools/website/update.ps1

# 本地预览（开发服务器，包含草稿）
cd tools/website && hugo server -D

Important Notes#

  • Automatically generated content (daily reports, weekly reports, etc.) is written directly to tools/website/content|static
  • Generated files are marked as gadget_generated; handwritten files will not be overwritten
  • tools/website/public/ is a separate deployment repository, automatically committed and pushed by scripts; do not commit manually
  • Translation defaults to using local inference engines (no cloud LLM API calls)

Detailed Documentation#

  • Step-by-step tutorial: TUTORIAL.md#website
  • Tool source documentation: tools/website/CLAUDE.md

VI. Translator (Document Translator)#

Function Description#

A Gradio web translator based on local inference engines:

  • Supports text and file translation (.md, .txt, .pdf, .docx, images)
  • Preserves Markdown format (code blocks, URLs, Hugo shortcodes, etc.)
  • Local inference, no cloud calls
  • Supports automatic source language detection (based on CJK ratio)
  • Automatically switches between zh↔en when the target language is auto

Installation and Running#

# 安装翻译工具依赖（gradio + GGUF 翻译栈）
pip install -e ".[translator]"

# 启动 Gradio GUI（自动打开浏览器）
python -m translator

Environment Variable Configuration#

# 指定翻译模型（默认为 tencent/Hy-MT2-1.8B）
export GADGET_TRANSLATION_MODEL=your-model-name

# 指定翻译后端（默认 ollama，其他选项：llamacpp, vllm, transformers）
export GADGET_TRANSLATION_BACKEND=ollama

Automatic Model Download#

Upon first use, the default model tencent/Hy-MT2-1.8B will be automatically downloaded (or use GGUF variants).

Detailed Documentation#

  • Step-by-step tutorial: TUTORIAL.md#translator

VII. Operations Scripts (Scripts)#

Data Synchronization#

# 中央化 rclone 数据同步（push/pull/status 等）
python scripts/sync.py

# 配置文件：repo 根目录的 config.json 的 sync 部分
# 覆盖路径：GADGET_CONFIG 环境变量

Health Check#

# 轻量级无写入测试（--help / --info / imports，无 LLM 调用）
bash scripts/smoke.sh

Local LLM Service#

# 创建 summarize 优化的 Ollama 变体
eval "$(bash scripts/serve_local_llm.sh env)"

Other Scripts#

  • language.py: Hugo bilingual audit + report renaming
  • profile_translation.py: Translation engine GPU performance analysis

VIII. Global Configuration#

Environment Variables#

Environment Variable Description Default Value
GADGET_CONFIG Custom configuration file path config.json
GADGET_LLM_BACKEND LLM backend (global) ollama
GADGET_TRANSLATION_MODEL Translation model tencent/Hy-MT2-1.8B
GADGET_TRANSLATION_BACKEND Translation inference engine ollama

LLM Backend Selection#

All tools switch backends uniformly via the --api parameter:| Backend | Description | API Key Required | |——|——|———–| | ollama | Local Ollama server (default, using Gemma4-26B) | ❌ None | | claude_cli | Claude Code CLI (no separate API key needed) | ❌ None | | anthropic | Anthropic API | ✅ Required | | openai | OpenAI API | ✅ Required |

Translation Inference Engine Selection#

Specify via GADGET_TRANSLATION_BACKEND (in priority order):

  1. ollama (preferred): Local Ollama server, using gemma4:26b chat model
  2. llamacpp: GGUF low VRAM option
  3. vllm: High-performance inference on Linux
  4. transformers: Alternative for Windows, using tencent/Hy-MT2-1.8B

IX. Quick Reference Cheat Sheet for Common Operations#

# 一键启动所有依赖（Python 3.10+ conda 环境）
conda activate AI
pip install -e ".[all]"
pip install -e ".[translator]"

# 快速健康检查

# 生成日报（最常用）

python -m summarize daily merge --sync-all

# 启动翻译服务

# 本地预览博客
cd tools/website && hugo server -D

# 查看具体工具帮助
python -m summarize --help
python tools/research/research_scout.py --help
cd tools/benchmark && python -m benchmark.cli --help

X. Complete Getting Started Workflow#

# 1. 克隆仓库
git clone <url>
cd gadget

# 2. 创建虚拟环境
conda create -n AI python=3.10

# 6. 尝试第一个工具（以翻译器为例）

# 7. 查看生成的文件
ls -la outputs/

XI. Output File Organization#

All generated artifacts are located in the outputs/ directory (already .gitignore’d):

outputs/
├── logs/        # 中间产物（导出日志、运行日志）
├── reports/     # 最终报告（Markdown、JSON、HTML）
├── cache/       # LLM 缓存、搜索缓存
├── data/        # 结构化数据（CSV、JSON 档案）
├── images/      # 图表和生成的图片
└── backups/     # 强制覆盖备份（website-force 等）

Hugo website content is written directly to tools/website/content|static (no separate outputs/site staging tree).

XII. Important Notes#

  • ❌ Do not git add automatically generated content, rclone synced data, build artifacts (build/, gadget.egg-info/), or deployment repositories
  • ✅ All tools manage LLM backends uniformly via the --api parameter
  • ✅ Tokens and API keys are placed in the tokens/ directory (already .gitignore’d)
  • ✅ Local translation and inference involve no cloud calls, protecting privacy
  • ✅ Each tool is independent within its tools/<tool>/ directory and can be used separately

I. Project Summary#

What is the project?#

Gadget is a collection of practical tools accumulated by a developer in daily life, covering five areas: AI daily report generation, paper discovery, performance benchmarking, blog automation, and document translation. Each tool is independently available and shares the underlying infrastructure package common/.

Repository Structure#

gadget/
├── tools/          # 五个独立工具
│   ├── summarize/  # AI 对话日/周/月报

Tool Function
summarize Reads AI conversation logs from multiple devices (Claude Code/Codex/Cursor/ChatGPT), calls LLM to generate structured daily/weekly/monthly reports; supports ccusage 20.x for token usage and cost statistics
research Searches for papers from arXiv/bioRxiv/PubMed/Semantic Scholar, features a three-stage LLM evaluation (fast screening → deep assessment → citation impact), supports researcher profiling, citation graph analysis, and deep paper insights
benchmark Cross-platform CPU/GPU FLOPS benchmarking, supports NVIDIA CUDA / Apple MPS / Intel XPU, covers FP64~FP8 precision, appends results to CSV, and can generate Plotly interactive HTML reports

scripts Operations scripts: sync.py (rclone data sync), onboard.py (one-click configuration for new machines), smoke.sh (smoke tests)

II. Detailed Usage Tutorial#

Environment Preparation#

Prerequisites:

  • Python 3.10+ (recommended to use conda environment AI)
  • Node.js 18+ (only required for Companion diagrams and DAG publishing)
# 推荐：激活 conda 环境
conda activate AI

First step after cloning the repository — Installing base packages:

# 安装 common 包 + summarize/research/benchmark/website 扩展（不含 translator）
pip install -e ".[all]"

# 如果需要 translator，单独安装
pip install -e ".[translator]"

Configuration file preparation:

Tool settings are stored in config.json at the repository root (already gitignored); start by copying one from the example files:

cp config.example.json config.json
# 然后编辑 config.json 填入你的配置

The configuration file path can be overridden via the GADGET_CONFIG environment variable.

API Keys:

Keys are stored in the tokens/ directory (already gitignored, DO NOT git add).

One-click Configuration for New Machines (Optional)#

For a brand new machine, you can use onboard.py to automatically complete SSH configuration, CLI installation and authentication, pip extension installation, and rclone bootstrap:

# 1. 填写配置表
# 编辑 tokens/onboard.yaml

# 2. 运行一次
python scripts/onboard.py

Tool 1: summarize — AI Daily/Weekly/Monthly Reports#

LLM Backend Selection#

Switch via the --api parameter; four options:

  • ollama (default, local Ollama, no API key needed, uses Gemma4-26B)
  • claude_cli (reuses Claude Code CLI login status, no API key needed)
  • anthropic
  • openai

Typical Usage#

Two-stage workflow (multi-device scenario):

# 第一阶段：在每台设备上导出尚未导出的日期
python -m summarize daily export

# 第二阶段：同步所有日期并逐天合并生成日报
python -m summarize daily merge --sync-all

Generate weekly report (and deploy to Hugo):

python -m summarize weekly generate --week 2026-W12 --deploy

Generate monthly report (and deploy to Hugo):

python -m summarize monthly generate --month 2026-02 --deploy

One-click full process (Export → Merge → Weekly Report → Monthly Report + Deploy):

python -m summarize auto --deploy

The old entry point python tools/summarize/daily_summary.py ... is still available (backward compatible), but using the python -m summarize format is recommended.

Tool 2: research — Paper Discovery and Researcher Analysis#

Entry script: tools/research/research_scout.py

Typical Usage#

Full paper search pipeline (Search → Three-stage evaluation → Generate report):

python tools/research/research_scout.py report --project my-project

Natural language search (automatic data source routing):

python tools/research/research_scout.py ask "找 Pieter Abbeel 最近的机器人操作论文"

Researcher profile analysis:

python tools/research/research_scout.py profile "Sergey Levine"

Citation graph analysis (pass arXiv ID or DOI):

python tools/research/research_scout.py citations 2301.12597

Deploy report to Hugo:

python tools/research/research_scout.py deploy

All LLM functions also support switching backends via the --api parameter (same four options as summarize).

Tool 3: benchmark — Performance Benchmarking#

Note: All commands must first be cd to tools/benchmark/.

cd tools/benchmark

Typical Usage#

Run all benchmarks (results appended to CSV, does not overwrite historical data):

python -m benchmark.cli

Test CPU only:

python -m benchmark.cli --cpu-only

Test GPU only:

python -m benchmark.cli --gpu-only

Run tests + generate interactive HTML report:

python -m benchmark.cli --report

Generate report and publish to Hugo /benchmark/:

python -m benchmark.cli --report --deploy

Automatic GPU type detection (NVIDIA CUDA / Apple MPS / Intel XPU), precision coverage: FP64 / FP32 / FP16 / BF16 / FP8 (experimental).

Tool 4: website — Hugo Blog#

Install dependencies (includes torch + transformers for translation):

pip install -e ".[website]"

Typical Usage#

macOS / Linux — Incremental compression + Hugo build + push to GitHub Pages:

cd tools/website && bash update.sh

Windows — Equivalent PowerShell script:

powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tools/website/update.ps1

Local preview (development server, includes drafts):

cd tools/website && hugo server -D

tools/website/public/ is an independent deployment repository, automatically committed and pushed by the build script; do not manually commit to this directory.

Tool 5: translator — Gradio Document Translator#

Install dependencies:

pip install -e ".[translator]"

Start Gradio Web UI (automatically opens in browser):

python -m translator
  • Supported formats: .md / .txt / .pdf / .docx / images
  • Default model: tencent/Hy-MT2-1.8B (automatically downloaded on first run)
  • Switch models via GADGET_TRANSLATION_MODEL environment variable or within the GUI model management
  • When source language is set to auto, it auto-detects based on CJK ratio; when target language is set to auto, it auto-switches between zh↔en

Data Synchronization (Multi-device)#

# 推送本地数据到云端
python scripts/sync.py push

# 从云端拉取数据
python scripts/sync.py pull

# 查看同步状态
python scripts/sync.py status

Requires rclone to be configured in advance (can be completed automatically via scripts/onboard.py).

Smoke Test (Verify installation is normal)#

Perform read-only smoke checks on all tools (no LLM calls, no network, no writes):

bash scripts/smoke.sh

Global Environment Variable Cheat Sheet#

Variable Purpose Default Value
GADGET_CONFIG Overrides config.json path Repository root config.json
GADGET_LLM_BACKEND Globally switch LLM backend ollama
GADGET_TRANSLATION_BACKEND Switch translation inference engine ollama

Gadget Project Summary#

What it is#

Gadget is a collection of practical tools accumulated during daily development, covering five major functions: AI daily report generation, paper discovery, performance benchmarking, blog automation, and document translation. Each tool is independently available, with shared infrastructure unified in the common/ package.

Repository Structure#

Directory Role
tools/summarize/ AI conversation daily/weekly/monthly report generation
tools/research/ Paper discovery + Scholar analysis + Citation graph
tools/benchmark/ CPU/GPU performance benchmarking
tools/website/ Hugo blog (incremental media compression + automatic build & publish)
tools/translator/ Gradio document translator
common/ Shared infrastructure package (LLM calls, cache, IO, translation, Hugo deployment)
scripts/ Operations scripts (data synchronization, new machine configuration, etc.)
docs/ Design documents, audit reports
outputs/ All generated artifacts (gitignored)

Tool Functions#

  • Summarize: Reads AI conversation logs from multiple platforms (Claude Code / Codex / Cursor / ChatGPT, etc.) and generates structured daily, weekly, and monthly reports via LLM. Supports multi-device aggregation and uses ccusage 20.x to statistics token usage and costs. Four LLM backends: ollama (default), claude_cli, anthropic, openai.
  • Research: A unified academic research toolkit—paper searching (arXiv/bioRxiv/PubMed, three-stage LLM filtering), deep paper insights (full-text analysis + OpenReview reviews), scholar profiling (paper/citation data + mentor-student relationship discovery), and citation graph analysis.
  • Benchmark: Cross-platform CPU/GPU FLOPS benchmarking, supporting NVIDIA CUDA / Apple MPS / Intel XPU, multiple precisions (FP64/FP32/FP16/BF16/FP8), results appended to CSV, can generate Plotly interactive HTML reports and deploy them to Hugo.
  • Website: Hugo static blog, featuring a built-in incremental image/video compression pipeline (pngquant + HandBrakeCLI) and local model bilingual translation (default Ollama, translation model tencent/Hy-MT2-1.8B is automatically downloaded on first run), with automatic build and push to GitHub Pages.
  • Translator: A Gradio-based local document translation web interface, supporting .md/.txt/.pdf/.docx/images, preserving Markdown formatting, performing local inference without calling cloud APIs, and automatically selecting backends (ollama/transformers/vllm/llamacpp).
  • common/: The shared layer for all tools—unified LLM calls (four backends), JSON parsing fixes, SHA-256 disk caching, atomic writes, local translation engine, and Hugo deployment.
  • scripts/: sync.py (rclone data sync), onboard.py (one-click new machine configuration), smoke.sh (read-only smoke tests), serve_local_llm.sh (Ollama variant creation), etc.

Gadget User Guide#

I. Environment Preparation#

  1. Python 3.10+, conda environment recommended:

    conda activate AI

  2. Node.js 18+ (only required for Companion graphs and DAG publishing, optional)

  3. Tool-specific dependencies: Each tool directory contains requirements.txt

II. Installation#

After cloning the repository, install the shared package in the repository root:

# 安装 common 包 + summarize/research/benchmark/website 的依赖
pip install -e ".[all]"

# translator 需要单独安装
pip install -e ".[translator]"

# 或只装 website 相关
pip install -e ".[website]"

III. Configuration#

  • Tool configurations are located in the repository root at config.json (gitignored); copy from config.example.json:

    cp config.example.json config.json

    The path can be overridden via the GADGET_CONFIG environment variable.

  • API keys and configurations are placed in the tokens/ directory (gitignored, do not commit).

  • LLM backends are switched uniformly via the --api parameter: ollama (default, keyless), claude_cli (reuses Claude Code login state), anthropic, openai. Can also be set globally via the GADGET_LLM_BACKEND environment variable.

  • Translation backends are selected via GADGET_TRANSLATION_BACKEND: ollama (default) → llamacpp/vllm/transformers.

One-click Configuration for New Machines#

Fill in tokens/onboard.yaml, then run:

python scripts/onboard.py

to automatically complete SSH configuration, CLI installation authentication, pip dependencies, tool configuration, and rclone onboarding.

IV. Using Each Tool#

1. Summarize — AI Conversation Daily/Weekly/Monthly Reports#

# 阶段一：导出所有未导出的日期
python -m summarize daily export

python -m summarize daily merge --sync-all

python -m summarize weekly generate --week 2026-W12 --deploy

# 生成月报并部署

python tools/research/research_scout.py citations 2301.12597

3. Benchmark — Performance Benchmarking#

cd tools/benchmark

cd tools/website && bash update.sh

# 启动 Gradio 界面（自动打开浏览器）

Default model is tencent/Hy-MT2-1.8B (GGUF variant tencent/Hy-MT2-1.8B-GGUF), which is automatically downloaded on first use. You can switch via the GADGET_TRANSLATION_MODEL environment variable or the in-interface model management. Source language supports auto (detected by CJK ratio), and when the target language is auto, it automatically flips between Chinese and English.

V. Operations Scripts#

# 数据同步（push/pull/status/bootstrap/config）

VI. Important Notes#

  • The tokens/ directory stores API keys and is gitignored; never commit it.
  • outputs/ stores all generated artifacts and is gitignored; it can be automatically rebuilt.
  • Do not git add automatically generated content, rclone synchronized data, build artifacts (build/, gadget.egg-info/), or deployment/theme repositories under tools/website/.
  • GPU benchmarking automatically detects CUDA / Apple MPS / Intel XPU.
  • The project uses the GPL-3 license.

Tool Function
summarize Reads AI conversation logs from Claude Code / Codex / Cursor Agent / ChatGPT / general JSON, uses LLM to generate structured daily/weekly/monthly reports; uses ccusage 20.x to statistics token usage and costs across CLIs; multi-device two-stage architecture (export → aggregate/merge)

common/ Shared packages: LLM calls (unified API for four backends), JSON repair, SHA-256 disk cache, atomic writes, local translation engine, Hugo deployment
scripts/ sync.py (rclone cross-device sync), onboard.py (one-click initialization for new machines), smoke.sh (read-only smoke tests), serve_local_llm.sh, language.py, profile_translation.py

II. Usage Tutorial#

1. Environment Preparation#

  • Python 3.10+ (recommended conda environment AI : conda activate AI)
  • Node.js 18+ (only required for optional Companion graph / DAG publishing tools)

2. Installation#

# 基础 + summarize/research/benchmark/website 全部 extras（不含 translator）

# translator 需单独装

# website 单独装（含 torch + transformers 翻译）
pip install -e ".[website]"

3. Configuration#

  • Tool configurations are written in config.json at the repository root (gitignored, copy from config.example.json). Use GADGET_CONFIG environment variables to override paths.
  • API Keys and onboarding tables are in the tokens/ directory (gitignored).
  • LLM backends are switched via --api: ollama (default, local no-key, Gemma4-26B) / claude_cli (reuses Claude Code CLI login state) / anthropic / openai; also can be set globally via GADGET_LLM_BACKEND environment variable.
  • Translation backends are switched via GADGET_TRANSLATION_BACKEND: ollama (default, reuses gemma4:26b) → llamacpp / vllm / transformers (uses tencent/Hy-MT2-1.8B, automatic download on first use). Translation models can be overridden via GADGET_TRANSLATION_MODEL.

Automatically completes SSH configuration, Claude/Codex CLI installation and authentication, pip extras, configuration for each tool, and rclone bootstrap.

Old entry points like python tools/summarize/daily_summary.py are still available (backward compatible shim), but the new format python -m summarize is recommended.

Research — Paper Discovery and Scholar Analysis#

# 完整流水线：搜索 → 三阶段评估 → 报告
python tools/research/research_scout.py report --project my-project

# 自然语言搜索（自动路由数据源）
python tools/research/research_scout.py ask "找 Pieter Abbeel 最近的机器人操作论文"

# 学者画像
python tools/research/research_scout.py profile "Sergey Levine"

# 引用图（按 arXiv ID / DOI）
python tools/research/research_scout.py citations 2301.12597

# 把报告部署到 Hugo
python tools/research/research_scout.py deploy

All LLM functions can be added with --api ollama|claude_cli|anthropic|openai.

Benchmark — Performance Benchmarking#

cd tools/benchmark

python -m benchmark.cli                   # 跑全部（结果追加到 CSV）
python -m benchmark.cli --cpu-only        # 只跑 CPU
python -m benchmark.cli --gpu-only        # 只跑 GPU
python -m benchmark.cli --report          # 跑完生成 HTML 报告
python -m benchmark.cli --report --deploy # 生成报告并发布到 Hugo /benchmark/

Website — Hugo Blog#

pip install -e ".[website]"

# macOS / Linux：增量压缩 + Hugo 构建 + 推送 Pages
cd tools/website && bash update.sh

# Windows
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tools/website/update.ps1

# 本地预览（含草稿）
cd tools/website && hugo server -D

tools/website/public/ is an independent deployment repository; scripts commit and push automatically, do not manually git add.

Translator — Gradio Document Translator#

pip install -e ".[translator]"
python -m translator          # 启动 Gradio GUI（浏览器自动打开）

Source language can be set to auto (detected by CJK ratio); when target is set to auto, it flips between zh↔en. Default model is tencent/Hy-MT2-1.8B, automatic download on first use.

Cross-device Data Synchronization#

python scripts/sync.py push       # 推
python scripts/sync.py pull       # 拉
python scripts/sync.py status
python scripts/sync.py bootstrap
python scripts/sync.py config

Configured in the sync section of config.json.

5. Precautions#
