  • License is GPL-3.
opus-4.8 — 6,270 chars · 16/16 facts

I. Project Summary#

What is this#

Gadget is a collection of practical tools accumulated during daily development, packaged with Python (GPL-3 license). It covers five major capabilities: AI conversation daily/weekly/monthly report generation, paper discovery and researcher analysis, hardware performance benchmarking, Hugo blog automation, and document translation. The design philosophy is: each directory under tools/ is a tool that can be used independently, while common capabilities (LLM calls, JSON parsing, disk cache, atomic writes, translation, Hugo deployment) are centralized in the common/ package at the repository root, installed via pip install -e ..

Repository Structure#

Directory/File Role
tools/summarize/ AI conversation daily/weekly/monthly reports (multi-device two-stage architecture)
tools/research/ Paper discovery + researcher analysis + citation graphs
tools/benchmark/ Cross-platform CPU/GPU performance benchmarks
tools/website/ Hugo blog (incremental media compression + automatic build and publish)
tools/translator/ Gradio document translator
common/ Shared infrastructure package used by all tools
scripts/ Operations/maintenance scripts (sync.py, onboard.py, language.py, profile_translation.py, etc.)
docs/ Design documents, ECL plans, audit reports, historical archives
outputs/ All generated artifacts (gitignore, rebuildable)
AGENTS.md Working protocols for all AI agents
CLAUDE.md Claude Code repository guide
pyproject.toml common/ and packaging configurations for each tool

Additionally, ../ai-companion/ (an independent sibling repository) provides optional DAG publishing tools.

What each tool does#

  • Summarize: Automatically reads daily AI conversation logs (Claude Code / Codex / Cursor Agent / ChatGPT / general JSON), calls LLM to generate structured daily/weekly/monthly summaries. Multi-device workflow: export conversation logs from each device → sync via cloud drive or manual aggregation → generate daily reports → accumulate to generate weekly reports and monthly trends. Uses ccusage 20.x source-specific commands to automatically statistics token usage and costs for each agent CLI. Four backends: ollama (default, local no-key), claude_cli, anthropic, openai, switched via --api.- Research: A unified academic research tool with a single entry point research_scout.py. Four core capabilities: ① Paper discovery (arXiv/bioRxiv/PubMed, three-stage LLM pipeline: fast screening → deep evaluation → citation impact, generates research weekly reports and deploys to Hugo); ② Deep paper insights (--insight, download full text, analyze writing structure, match OpenReview reviews); ③ Researcher profiling (ArXiv + Semantic Scholar, research trajectory analysis, hierarchical scoring, mentor-student relationship discovery); ④ Citation graph analysis (forward citations/backward references based on Semantic Scholar API).

  • Benchmark: Cross-platform CPU/GPU FLOPS benchmarking. Supports actual execution on NVIDIA(CUDA), Apple Silicon(MPS), and Intel(XPU), covering FP64/FP32/FP16/BF16/FP8 (experimental). Uses warm-up + formal measurement + statistical analysis (median, IQR for outlier removal); results are written to CSV in append mode (naturally supporting multi-hardware cumulative leaderboards), can generate Plotly interactive HTML reports for deployment and submission to public leaderboards.

  • Website: Hugo static blog (“TzJ’s Net”, PaperMod theme, deployed to GitHub Pages). Built-in incremental image/video compression (only processes media changed since .last_build: images via pngquant, videos via HandBrakeCLI) and local model bilingual translation (default Ollama; uses vLLM for Linux and transformers as a fallback for Windows; model tencent/Hy-MT2-1.8B is automatically downloaded on first run). Automatically generated content is written directly to tools/website/content|static; only files with gadget_generated tags will be overwritten, while hand-written files remain untouched. tools/website/public/ is an independent deployment repository, automatically committed and pushed by build scripts; do not commit to it directly.

  • Translator: A Gradio-based document translator powered by the common translation engine, similar to a local version of Google Translate. Translates text and files (.md/.txt/.pdf/.docx/images), preserving Markdown formatting (code blocks, URLs, and Hugo shortcodes are protected). Uses local inference instead of cloud APIs, with automatic engine selection (Ollama preferred / transformers fallback for Windows / vLLM preferred for Linux / llamacpp as a low-VRAM GGUF option); models reside in memory. Default model is tencent/Hy-MT2-1.8B, can be overridden via GADGET_TRANSLATION_MODEL.

  • common/: The shared layer, providing a unified two-level LLM API (four backends), JSON parsing fixes, SHA-256 disk caching (namespace + TTL), atomic writes with content hashing, local inference translation engine, and cross-platform Hugo deployment.

  • scripts/: sync.py (rclone data synchronization: push/pull/status/bootstrap/config, including special dag categories); onboard.py (one-time new machine configuration); smoke.sh (read-only smoke tests); serve_local_llm.sh (creates a dedicated summarize Ollama variant); language.py, profile_translation.py.

II. Detailed Tutorial (For Beginners)#

1. Environment Preparation#

  • Python 3.10+ (recommended to use conda environment AI): 
    conda activate AI
  • Node.js 18+ (only required for optional Companion graph / DAG publishing tools)
  • For specific dependencies of each tool, see the corresponding directory’s requirements.txt
  • website/translation functions use a local inference engine (default Ollama, use gemma4:26b; Linux uses vLLM, Windows uses transformers as fallback, use tencent/Hy-MT2-1.8B, automatically downloads on first run)

2. Installation#

Install the common package + extras for summarize/research/benchmark/website:

pip install -e ".[all]"

Note: all does not include translator, which must be installed separately:

pip install -e ".[translator]"

Translation dependencies for website (includes torch + transformers):

pip install -e ".[website]"

Executing pip install -e . will generate build/ and gadget.egg-info/ (already gitignored) in the repository root.

3. Configuration#

  • Tool settings are located in config.json at the repository root (gitignored, copied from config.example.json). Use GADGET_CONFIG to override paths.
  • The tokens/ directory stores API keys and onboarding tables (gitignored, do not commit).
  • LLM backends are unified and switched via --api: ollama (default), claude_cli, anthropic, openai; can also be set globally via environment variable GADGET_LLM_BACKEND.
  • The backend for translation paths is selected via GADGET_TRANSLATION_BACKEND: ollama (default) → llamacpp/vllm/transformers.

One-time configuration for new machines (after filling in tokens/onboard.yaml):

python scripts/onboard.py

Cross-device data synchronization (requires rclone configuration):

python scripts/sync.py        # 查看/运行同步

Full-tool read-only smoke test (does not touch LLM/network/writes):

bash scripts/smoke.sh

4. Typical Usage for Each Tool#

Summarize#

python -m summarize daily export                              # 阶段1:导出所有未导出的日期
python -m summarize daily merge --sync-all                    # 阶段2:同步所有日期并逐日合并
python -m summarize weekly generate --week 2026-W12 --deploy  # 周报 + 部署
python -m summarize monthly generate --month 2026-02 --deploy # 月报 + 部署
python -m summarize auto --deploy                             # 一键全流程:导出→合并→周报→月报 + 部署

The old entry point python tools/summarize/daily_summary.py ..., etc., is still compatible, but the above python -m summarize format is recommended.

Research#

python tools/research/research_scout.py report --project my-project        # 全流程:搜索→三阶段评估→报告
python tools/research/research_scout.py ask "找 Pieter Abbeel 最近的机器人操作论文"  # 自然语言搜索(自动路由来源)
python tools/research/research_scout.py profile "Sergey Levine"             # 研究者画像
python tools/research/research_scout.py citations 2301.12597               # 引用图谱(按 arXiv ID / DOI)
python tools/research/research_scout.py deploy                              # 把报告部署到 Hugo

Use --insight for deep paper insights. All LLM functions support switching backends via --api.

Benchmark#

cd tools/benchmark                         # 注意:所有命令都要先 cd 进该目录
python -m benchmark.cli                     # 跑全部基准(结果追加到 CSV)
python -m benchmark.cli --cpu-only          # 仅 CPU
python -m benchmark.cli --gpu-only          # 仅 GPU
python -m benchmark.cli --report            # 跑基准 + 生成 HTML 报告
python -m benchmark.cli --report --deploy   # 生成报告 + 发布到 Hugo /benchmark/

(Hardware detection is available via --info.)

Website#

pip install -e ".[website]"                          # 安装依赖(含翻译用 torch + transformers)
cd tools/website && bash update.sh                   # macOS/Linux:增量压缩 + Hugo 构建 + 推送 Pages
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tools/website/update.ps1  # Windows(脚本自己会 cd 到所在目录)
cd tools/website && hugo server -D                   # 本地预览(含草稿的开发服务器)

Translator#

pip install -e ".[translator]"   # 安装依赖(gradio + GGUF 翻译栈)
python -m translator             # 启动 Gradio GUI(浏览器打开)

5. Output and Precautions#

  • All generated products are in outputs/ (gitignored, can be rebuilt): logs/ intermediate products, reports/ final reports, cache/ cache, data/ structured data, images/ charts, backups/ backups. Hugo site content is written directly to tools/website/content|static.
  • Do not git add automatically generated content, rclone synchronized data, build products (build/, gadget.egg-info/), or deployment/theme repositories under tools/website/.

Note: Everything above is from the README; I have not fabricated any unmentioned commands/parameters (such as TUTORIAL.md or details in each tool’s source documentation). For step-by-step operations, data formats, and FAQs for each tool, please refer to the TUTORIAL.md pointed to by the README and the respective tool’s built-in documentation.

python tools/research/research_scout.py report --project my-project       # 全流程:搜索→三阶段评估→报告
python tools/research/research_scout.py ask "找 Pieter Abbeel 最近的机器人操作论文"  # 自然语言搜索
python tools/research/research_scout.py profile "Sergey Levine"            # 研究者画像
python tools/research/research_scout.py citations 2301.12597              # 引用图(arXiv ID / DOI)
python tools/research/research_scout.py deploy                             # 部署报告到 Hugo
  • --insight can perform deep analysis of full papers (including OpenReview reviews), but the README does not provide the complete command; please refer to tools/research/TUTORIAL.md.
  • Similarly supports switching backends via --api.

3. Benchmark: Performance Benchmarking#

All commands must first enter tools/benchmark/:

cd tools/benchmark
python -m benchmark.cli                    # 运行全部测试(结果追加到 CSV)
python -m benchmark.cli --cpu-only         # 只测 CPU
python -m benchmark.cli --gpu-only         # 只测 GPU
python -m benchmark.cli --report           # 测试 + 生成 HTML 报告
python -m benchmark.cli --report --deploy  # 生成报告并发布到 Hugo 的 /benchmark/
  • Results are written to CSV in an append mode and will not be overwritten, making it suitable for accumulating leaderboards across multiple machines.
  • README mentions that --info can be used for hardware detection (OpenCL will only appear within it); see tools/benchmark/tutorial.md for full usage.

4. Website: Hugo Blog#

pip install -e ".[website]"                                          # 安装依赖
cd tools/website && bash update.sh                                   # macOS/Linux:增量压缩 + Hugo 构建 + 推送 Pages
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tools/website/update.ps1    # Windows
cd tools/website && hugo server -D                                   # 本地预览(含草稿)

Note:

  • Only compresses media files that have changed since .last_build.
  • Translation uses local models; the first run will automatically download tencent/Hy-MT2-1.8B.
  • Automatically generated content carries the gadget_generated tag; handwritten files without this tag will not be overwritten.
  • tools/website/public/ is an independent deployment repository (tzj2006/tzj2006.github.io), which is automatically committed and pushed by build scripts; do not commit manually.

5. Translator: Gradio Translator#

pip install -e ".[translator]"
python -m translator

A local webpage will open in your browser.

  • Supports text and .md/.txt/.pdf/.docx/图片, preserving Markdown format.
  • Source language can be set to auto (detected by CJK ratio); when the target language is auto, it automatically switches between Chinese ↔ English.
  • The default model is automatically downloaded upon first use; you can change it via GADGET_TRANSLATION_MODEL or the model management within the interface.

6. Data Synchronization (scripts/sync.py)#

python scripts/sync.py
  • Supports push / pull / status / bootstrap / config, covering summarize / website / research / benchmark / backups categories, with an additional special dag category.
  • Configuration is located in the sync section of config.json, and rclone must be configured first.
  • Specific usage mentioned in README includes python scripts/sync.py push/pull and python scripts/sync.py --category dag.

V. Output Locations#

All artifacts are located in outputs/ (already gitignored, can be rebuilt): logs/, reports/, cache/, data/, images/, backups/. Hugo site content is written directly to tools/website/content|static.

VI. Precautions#

  • Do not git add automatically generated content, rclone synchronized data, build/, gadget.egg-info/, as well as the deployment and theme repositories under tools/website/.
  • Do not commit the contents of tokens/.
  • To change tool logic, go to tools/<tool>/; to change shared capabilities, go to common/.
  • For more detailed steps, see TUTORIAL.md, the Chinese version is docs/README.zh.md.

VII. Suggested Onboarding Order#

  1. conda activate AI → pip install -e ".[all]"
  2. cp config.example.json config.json, and prepare Ollama (or switch to --api claude_cli)
  3. bash scripts/smoke.sh to verify installation
  4. Try the simplest cd tools/benchmark && python -m benchmark.cli --cpu-only first, then try python -m translator
  5. Afterwards, configure tools that depend on LLM such as summarize / research

I. Project Summary#

What it is#

Gadgets is a collection of practical tools accumulated during daily development, covering AI daily report generation, paper discovery, performance benchmarking, blog automation, and document translation. Each directory under tools/ is an independently usable tool; shared capabilities are centralized in the common/ package in the repository root (installed via pip install -e .), providing general functions such as LLM calls, JSON parsing, disk caching, atomic writes, translation, Hugo deployment, etc. The license is GPL-3.

Repository Structure#

gadget/
├── tools/              # 五个独立工具产品（改工具就来这里）
│   ├── summarize/      # AI 对话日报 / 周报 / 月报
│   ├── research/       # 论文发现 + 学者分析 + 引用图谱
│   ├── benchmark/      # CPU/GPU 性能基准测试
│   ├── website/        # Hugo 博客（增量媒体压缩 + 自动构建发布）
│   └── translator/     # Gradio 文档翻译器
├── common/             # 共享基础设施包（LLM / 缓存 / IO / 翻译 / Hugo），所有工具依赖
├── scripts/            # 运维维护脚本（sync.py、onboard.py、language.py、profile_translation.py…）
├── docs/               # 设计文档、ECL 计划（docs/ecl/）、审计报告、历史归档（docs/archive/）
├── outputs/            # 所有生成产物（gitignore，可自动重建）
├── AGENTS.md           # 所有 AI agent 的工作流协议（动手前先读）
├── CLAUDE.md           # Claude Code 的仓库指南
└── pyproject.toml      # common/ 与各工具的打包配置

outputs/ is divided into logs/ (intermediate products), reports/ (final reports in MD/JSON/HTML), cache/ (LLM and search cache), data/ (CSV, JSON profile), images/ (charts and generated images), and backups/ (backups before forced overwrite). Hugo site content is written directly to tools/website/content|static, without a separate outputs/site staging directory. build/ and gadget.egg-info/ are generated by pip install -e ., located in the repository root and already gitignored.

Where to go to change things:

Task Where to go
Change the logic of a specific tool tools/<tool>/
Change shared capabilities (LLM / Cache / Translation / Hugo deployment) common/
Change data synchronization scripts/sync.py
One-time configuration for new machines scripts/onboard.py
Change development workflow / a specific skill ai-companion repository (sibling ../ai-companion/ )
View plans / design documents docs/ecl/, docs/

What each tool does specificallytools/summarize —— AI Conversation Daily/Weekly/Monthly Reports#

Automatically reads daily AI conversation logs (Claude Code / Codex / Cursor Agent / ChatGPT / general JSON) and calls LLM APIs to generate structured daily, weekly, and monthly reports. Multi-device workflow: export conversation logs from various devices → sync via cloud drives or manual copy for aggregation → generate final daily reports; once enough daily reports are accumulated, generate weekly and monthly trend summaries. Automatically discovers and statistics token usage and costs for all agent CLI via the source namespace commands of ccusage 20.x https://github.com/ryoppippi/ccusage (ccusage claude, ccusage codex, ccusage gemini…). Key technologies: Claude/OpenAI API, ccusage 20.x (unified multi-source), matplotlib.

tools/research —— Paper Discovery and Scholar Analysis A unified academic research toolkit providing four major capabilities through a single CLI entry tools/research/research_scout.py:

  • Paper Discovery: Search for papers from arXiv / bioRxiv / PubMed using a three-stage LLM pipeline (fast screening → deep evaluation → citation impact), generating research weekly reports and deploying them to Hugo. Supports conference paper search and author search.
  • Deep Paper Insights (--insight): Download full-text papers and let the LLM analyze their writing structure, publication strategies, and reusable core knowledge; automatically match OpenReview to obtain review comments and analyze consensus vs. controversy; synthesize cross-paper research writing guides.
  • Scholar Profiling: Scrape paper and citation data from ArXiv + Semantic Scholar; LLM generates research trajectory analysis, calculates tier scores, and automatically discovers mentor-student relationships via homepage extraction + collaborator patterns. Supports name disambiguation and reverse lookup.
  • Citation Graph Analysis: Performs forward citation / backward reference analysis based on Semantic Scholar API, combined with LLM-driven impact interpretation.

tools/benchmark —— Performance Benchmark Suite A cross-platform CPU/GPU FLOPS benchmarking tool that uniformly measures floating-point performance across different hardware vendors and precision levels. GPU execution supports NVIDIA (CUDA), Apple Silicon (MPS), and Intel (XPU) (OpenCL may only appear in --info detection), covering precisions such as FP64 / FP32 / FP16 / BF16 / FP8 (experimental). The measurement method involves warmup + formal measurement + statistical analysis (median, IQR for outlier removal), and explicitly performs GPU synchronization to ensure timing accuracy. Results are accumulated in CSV in append mode (never overwritten, naturally supporting multi-hardware cumulative leaderboards), and can generate interactive HTML reports and leaderboards with Plotly charts, supporting deployment to Hugo websites and submission to public leaderboards.

tools/website —— Hugo Blog A Hugo static blog site (“TzJ’s Net”, PaperMod theme), deployed to GitHub Pages (https://tzj2006.github.io/). Includes a built-in incremental image/video compression pipeline (only compresses media changed after .last_build: images via pngquant, videos via HandBrakeCLI), and local model bilingual translation (defaults to Ollama, falls back to vLLM on Linux / transformers on Windows; model tencent/Hy-MT2-1.8B is automatically downloaded on its first run without using cloud LLM APIs). Auto-generated content (daily/weekly/monthly reports, research reports, benchmark pages, images) is written directly to tools/website/content|static by the deployment pipeline (the unique Hugo content root, files are tagged with gadget_generated; handwritten files without this tag are never overwritten), then translated, compressed, built, and pushed. tools/website/public/ is an independent deployment repository (tzj2006/tzj2006.github.io), which is automatically committed + pushed by build scripts—do not commit directly to it.

tools/translator —— Gradio Document Translator A Gradio document translator based on the common translation engine: a local translation web interface similar to Google Translate that translates text and files (.md / .txt / .pdf / .docx / images) while preserving Markdown formatting (code blocks, URLs, Hugo shortcodes, etc., are protected). Local inference instead of cloud APIs: reuses common.engine.create_engine() to automatically select backends (prioritizes ollama when a model tag is pulled; transformers is the Windows fallback, prioritizes vllm on Linux, and llamacpp is the low-VRAM GGUF option), with models residing in memory (warm) and lazy-loading on demand when switching models. Default model is tencent/Hy-MT2-1.8B (GGUF variant tencent/Hy-MT2-1.8B-GGUF), automatically downloaded on first use, and can be overridden via GADGET_TRANSLATION_MODEL or the GUI’s model management. Source language can be set to auto (detected by CJK text ratio); when the target language is auto, it flips between zh↔en.

common/ —— Shared Infrastructure Package The shared layer that all tools depend on, installed as a Python package via pip install -e .: LLM calls (unified two-layer API, supporting four backends: ollama (default) / claude_cli / anthropic / openai), JSON parsing and repair, SHA-256 disk cache (namespace + TTL), atomic writes and content hashing, local inference translation engine (Ollama / vLLM / transformers / GGUF) and bilingual content generation, and cross-platform Hugo deployment.

scripts/ —— Operations and Maintenance Scripts

  • sync.py —— Centralized rclone data synchronization (push / pull / status / bootstrap / config, covering summarize / website / research / benchmark / backups categories; includes a special dag category for generating + deploying DAG sites). Configuration is in the sync section of the repository root tools/research/TUTORIAL.md (paths can be overridden via GADGET_CONFIG).
  • onboard.py —— Repository-level one-time machine configuration: fill out a YAML table (tokens/onboard.yaml), run the script once, and it automatically completes SSH configuration, Claude/Codex CLI installation and authentication, pip extras installation, tool configurations, and rclone bootstrap.
  • smoke.sh —— Read-only smoke checks covering all tools (--help / --info / import; does not involve LLM, network, or writes).
  • serve_local_llm.sh —— Creates an Ollama variant optimized for summarize and prints environment variables. Persistent parameters are placed in the summarize section of the root config.json.
  • Others: language.py (Hugo bilingual audit + summarize report renaming), profile_translation.py (translation engine GPU profiler).

../ai-companion/ (Independent Repository) Provides the DAG publishing tool used by scripts/sync.py --category dag, as well as AI code change tracking + plan/execute skill pipelines + all skills (Node.js, TypeScript). The Companion tool is optional and must be explicitly run; this repository has no Companion interception hooks, and onboarding does not install Companion; old install.ai_companion settings will be ignored. Existing local idea graphs, manual graph commands, and skills remain available. Coding agents follow AGENTS.md, without being intercepted by Companion.

II. Usage Tutorial (For Beginners)#

The README itself is an overview; step-by-step operations, configurations, data formats, and FAQs for each tool can be found in TUTORIAL.md and each tool’s own source documentation. This tutorial only covers the commands and parameters explicitly mentioned in the README.

Step 0: Environment Preparation#

  • Python 3.10+ (conda environment AI is recommended)
  • Node.js 18+ (only if optional Companion graph and DAG publishing tools are needed)
  • Specific dependencies for each tool can be found in the corresponding directory’s requirements.txt
  • GPU benchmarks will automatically detect CUDA / Apple MPS / Intel XPU
  • website / translation functions use a local inference engine (defaults to Ollama, using the same gemma4:26b chat model for translation; falls back to vLLM on Linux / transformers on Windows, both using tencent/Hy-MT2-1.8B, which is automatically downloaded on first run)

Activate the recommended environment:

conda activate AI

Step 1: Installation#

# 安装 common 包 + summarize / research / benchmark / website 的 extras
pip install -e ".[all]"

Note: all does not include translator, which must be installed separately:

pip install -e ".[translator]"

You can also install individual extras as needed:

pip install -e ".[website]"      # 含翻译所需的 torch + transformers
pip install -e ".[translator]"   # gradio + GGUF 翻译栈

After installation, you can run a read-only smoke check (which does not trigger LLM, network, or writes) to confirm the environment is normal:

bash scripts/smoke.sh

Step 2: Configuration#

Tool Settings File: Tool settings are located in config.json at the repository root (already gitignored), copied from config.example.json:

cp config.example.json config.json

To use a different path, override it using the environment variable GADGET_CONFIG. Within this file, the sync section is for scripts/sync.py configuration, and the summarize section holds persistent parameters for serve_local_llm.sh.

Secrets Directory: The tokens/ directory stores API keys and onboarding tables; it is gitignored — never commit its contents.

LLM Backend: All tools switch backends uniformly via the --api parameter. Options include ollama (default, local Ollama, no key required, Gemma4-26B), claude_cli (reuses Claude Code CLI login state, no API key required), anthropic, and openai. You can also set this globally using the environment variable GADGET_LLM_BACKEND.Translation Backend: The translation path uses a local inference engine, selected by GADGET_TRANSLATION_BACKEND: ollama (default, local Ollama service, reusing the already serviced chat tag gemma4:26b) → llamacpp / vllm / transformers (in-process, model tencent/Hy-MT2-1.8B). The translation model can be overridden by GADGET_TRANSLATION_MODEL.

Local LLM Environment Variables: Create an Ollama variant optimized for summarize and export the environment:

eval "$(bash scripts/serve_local_llm.sh env)"

One-time Configuration for New Machines: After filling in tokens/onboard.yaml, run it once to automatically complete SSH configuration, Claude/Codex authentication, pip extras, tool configurations, and rclone bootstrap:

python scripts/onboard.py

Server System-level Installation (one-click installation of SSH public keys, Claude Code, Codex, Superpowers, Ponytail, and AI Companion on Ubuntu 22.04/24.04) scripts have been migrated to the ai-companion repository along with the platform. After the repository split, --companion-repo is directly sent to the ai-companion repository (git@github.com:TzJ2006/ai-companion.git), and --companion-ref is no longer required:

bash ../ai-companion/scripts/onboard-server.sh --help

Step 3: Data Synchronization (Cross-device)#

Cross-device data synchronization uses scripts/sync.py (requires rclone configuration first). Subcommands include push / pull / status / bootstrap / config, covering categories summarize / website / research / benchmark / backups, with a special dag category for generating + deploying DAG sites:

python scripts/sync.py            # 查看用法
python scripts/sync.py push      # 推送数据
python scripts/sync.py pull      # 拉取数据
python scripts/sync.py --category dag   # 生成 + 部署 DAG 站点

Step 4: Typical Usage of Each Tool#

Summarize —— AI Daily/Weekly/Monthly Reports#

Multi-device two-stage architecture: export from each device first, then aggregate and merge.

python -m summarize daily export                                   # 阶段 1：导出所有未导出的日期
python -m summarize daily merge --sync-all                         # 阶段 2：同步所有日期并逐日合并
python -m summarize weekly generate --week 2026-W12 --deploy       # 周报 + 部署
python -m summarize monthly generate --month 2026-02 --deploy      # 月报 + 部署
python -m summarize auto --deploy                                  # 一键全流程：导出 → 合并 → 周报 → 月报 + 部署

Switch AI summary backend (four backends unified using --api):

python -m summarize daily export --api claude_cli
python -m summarize daily export --api anthropic
python -m summarize daily export --api openai

Old entries python tools/summarize/daily_summary.py ... / weekly_summary.py / monthly_summary.py are still available (backward-compatible re-export shim), but the python -m summarize form mentioned above is recommended.

For detailed steps, see TUTORIAL.md#summarize and the source document tools/summarize/tutorial.md.

Research —— Paper Discovery and Scholar Analysis#

python tools/research/research_scout.py report --project my-project        # 全流程：搜索 → 三阶段评估 → 报告
python tools/research/research_scout.py ask "找 Pieter Abbeel 最近的机器人操作论文"  # 自然语言搜索（自动路由数据源）
python tools/research/research_scout.py profile "Sergey Levine"             # 学者画像
python tools/research/research_scout.py citations 2301.12597               # 引用图谱（按 arXiv ID / DOI）
python tools/research/research_scout.py deploy                              # 把报告部署到 Hugo

Use --insight for deep paper insights; all LLM features support switching backends via --api:

python tools/research/research_scout.py report --project my-project --api claude_cli

For detailed steps, see TUTORIAL.md#research and the source document tools/research/TUTORIAL.md.

Benchmark —— Performance Benchmarking#

Note: All commands require first cd into tools/benchmark/.

cd tools/benchmark
python -m benchmark.cli                    # 跑全部基准测试（结果追加到 CSV）
python -m benchmark.cli --cpu-only         # 只测 CPU
python -m benchmark.cli --gpu-only         # 只测 GPU
python -m benchmark.cli --report           # 跑基准测试 + 生成 HTML 报告
python -m benchmark.cli --report --deploy  # 生成报告 + 发布到 Hugo /benchmark/

Hardware detection is available via --info. Results are accumulated in CSV in append mode and never overwritten, so they can be run repeatedly on multiple machines to build a leaderboard.

For detailed steps, see TUTORIAL.md#benchmark and the source document tools/benchmark/tutorial.md.

Website —— Hugo Blog#

pip install -e ".[website]"                          # 安装依赖（含翻译用的 torch + transformers）

cd tools/website && bash update.sh                   # macOS/Linux：增量压缩 + Hugo 构建 + 推送 Pages

Under Windows (the script will cd to its own directory):

powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tools/website/update.ps1

Local preview (development server, including drafts):

cd tools/website && hugo server -D

Hugo bilingual audit (and summarize report renaming):

python scripts/language.py

Important: tools/website/public/ is an independent deployment repository (tzj2006/tzj2006.github.io), which is automatically committed + pushed by build scripts; do not commit directly to it. Automatically generated content carries the gadget_generated tag; handwritten files without tags will never be overwritten.

For detailed steps, see TUTORIAL.md#website and the source document tools/website/CLAUDE.md.

Translator —— Gradio Document Translator#

pip install -e ".[translator]"   # 安装依赖（gradio + GGUF 翻译栈）
python -m translator             # 启动 Gradio GUI（会在浏览器中打开）

After starting, paste text or upload files (.md / .txt / .pdf / .docx / images) in the web interface to translate. The source language can be set to auto (detected by CJK ratio); when the target language is set to auto, it flips between Chinese and English. To change the model, use environment variables:

GADGET_TRANSLATION_MODEL=tencent/Hy-MT2-1.8B-GGUF python -m translator

You can also switch in the Model Management within the GUI (lazy-loaded on demand). To change the inference backend:

GADGET_TRANSLATION_BACKEND=llamacpp python -m translator   # 低显存 GGUF
GADGET_TRANSLATION_BACKEND=vllm python -m translator       # Linux 优先
GADGET_TRANSLATION_BACKEND=transformers python -m translator  # Windows 回退

GPU performance analysis of the translation engine:

python scripts/profile_translation.py

For UI wiring, see tools/translator/app.py; for translation and file logic, see tools/translator/core.py]; for the shared engine, see common/engine.py and common/translation.py. For detailed steps, see TUTORIAL.md#translator.

Step 5: Essential Disciplines to Remember#

  • All generated files are output to the outputs/ directory, which is gitignored and can be automatically rebuilt.
  • NEVER git add: Automatically generated content, rclone synchronized data, build artifacts (build/, gadget.egg-info/), and the deployment and theme repositories under tools/website/.
  • Content in tokens/ must never be committed.
  • Read AGENTS.md (the workflow protocol for all AI agents) before modifying code; for Claude Code, see CLAUDE.md separately.

Gadget Project Summary#

What is this#

Gadget is a collection of practical tools accumulated during daily development, covering five major directions: AI daily report generation, paper discovery, performance benchmarking, blog automation, and document translation. Each directory under tools/ is an independently usable tool, with shared capabilities centralized in the common/ package at the repository root (installed via pip install -e .), providing general functions such as LLM calls, JSON parsing, disk caching, atomic writes, translation, Hugo deployment, etc. The project uses the GPL-3 license.

Repository Structure#

gadget/
├── tools/              # 五个独立工具
│   ├── summarize/      # AI 对话日报/周报/月报
│   ├── research/       # 论文发现 + 研究者分析 + 引用图谱
│   ├── benchmark/      # CPU/GPU 性能基准测试

There is also a sibling repository ../ai-companion/ (independent repo) providing DAG publishing tools and development workflow/skill-related content.

What Each Tool Does#

Tool Function
summarize Automatically reads AI conversation logs from various devices (Claude Code / Codex / Cursor Agent / ChatGPT / general JSON), calls LLMs to generate structured daily, weekly, and monthly reports; uses ccusage 20.x to statistics token usage and costs for each agent CLI. Multi-device two-stage architecture: export from each device → aggregate via cloud drive synchronization → merge to generate daily reports, then accumulate to generate weekly/monthly reports.
research Unified academic research tool (single entry point research_scout.py): ① Paper Discovery—arXiv/bioRxiv/PubMed three-stage LLM pipeline (fast screening → deep review → citation impact), generates research weekly reports and deploys them to Hugo; ② Deep Paper Insights (--insight)—downloads full text to analyze writing structure and automatically matches OpenReview reviews; ③ Researcher Profiling—generates research trajectory analysis, tier scores, and mentor-student relationship discovery based on ArXiv + Semantic Scholar; ④ Citation Graph Analysis.
benchmark Cross-platform CPU/GPU FLOPS benchmarking, supporting NVIDIA CUDA / Apple MPS / Intel XPU, covering FP64/FP32/FP16/BF16/FP8 (experimental). Includes Warm-up + Formal Measurement + Statistical Analysis (median, IQR for outlier removal), results are appended to CSV (naturally supporting multi-hardware cumulative leaderboards), and can generate Plotly interactive HTML reports deployed to Hugo.
website Hugo static blog (“TzJ’s Net”, PaperMod theme, deployed to GitHub Pages). Includes built-in incremental image/video compression (only compresses media that changed after .last_build: images via pngquant, videos via HandBrakeCLI) and local model bilingual translation. Automatically generated content is written directly to `tools/website/content
translator A Gradio-based local translation web app using the common translation engine, translating text and files (.md/.txt/.pdf/.docx/images) while preserving Markdown formatting (code blocks, URLs, and Hugo shortcodes are protected). Purely local inference, automatically selects backends (ollama / vllm / transformers / llamacpp), default model is tencent/Hy-MT2-1.8B, which is automatically downloaded upon first use.

Ops scripts in scripts/: sync.py (rclone data sync, push/pull/status/bootstrap/config), onboard.py (one-time configuration for new machines), smoke.sh (read-only smoke tests), serve_local_llm.sh (create Ollama variants optimized for summarize), language.py (Hugo bilingual audit), profile_translation.py (translation engine GPU performance analysis).

Tutorial (For Beginners)#

I. Environment Preparation#

  1. Python 3.10+, recommended to use conda environment AI: 
    conda activate AI
  2. Node.js 18+ (optional, only required for Companion graph and DAG publishing tools).
  3. For specific dependencies of each tool, see requirements.txt in their respective directories.
  4. Local inference (website translation / translator) defaults to using Ollama (chat model gemma4:26b); Linux can use vLLM, and Windows can use transformers as fallback (using tencent/Hy-MT2-1.8B, automatically downloaded on first run).
  5. Cross-device data synchronization requires configuring rclone.

II. InstallationExecute in the repository root:#

# common 包 + summarize/research/benchmark/website 的依赖（注意：不含 translator）
pip install -e ".[all]"

# translator 需单独安装
pip install -e ".[translator]"

# 如只需 website（含翻译用的 torch + transformers）
pip install -e ".[website]"

Installation will generate build/ and gadget.egg-info/ in the repository root (gitignored, do not commit).

III. Configuration#

  • Main Configuration File: Repository root config.json (gitignored), copied from config.example.json; the path can be overridden using the environment variable GADGET_CONFIG. sync.py reads the sync section within it, and the persistence settings for summarize are located in the summarize section.
  • Keys: Placed in the tokens/ directory (gitignored, do not commit).
  • LLM Backend: All LLM features are unified and switched via the --api parameter, with four options: ollama (default, local Ollama, no key required, Gemma4-26B), claude_cli (reuses Claude Code CLI login state, no API key required), anthropic, and openai. The environment variable GADGET_LLM_BACKEND can also be used for global settings.
  • Translation Backend: Selected via GADGET_TRANSLATION_BACKEND (ollama default → llamacpp/vllm/transformers); translation models can be overridden via GADGET_TRANSLATION_MODEL.
  • One-time Configuration for New Machines: Fill in tokens/onboard.yaml and run once: 
    python scripts/onboard.py
    This will automatically complete SSH configuration, Claude/Codex CLI installation/authentication, pip extras installation, tool configurations, and rclone bootstrap.
  • Verify Installation (Read-only smoke test; does not call LLM, does not connect to the internet, does not write files): 
    bash scripts/smoke.sh

IV. Typical Usage of Each Tool#

1. Summarize — AI Chat Daily/Weekly/Monthly Reports#

A two-stage process for multiple devices: first export on each device, then merge and generate on the aggregation device.

python -m summarize daily export                                   # 阶段一：导出所有未导出日期
python -m summarize daily merge --sync-all                         # 阶段二：同步所有日期并逐日合并
python -m summarize weekly generate --week 2026-W12 --deploy       # 生成周报并部署
python -m summarize monthly generate --month 2026-02 --deploy      # 生成月报并部署
python -m summarize auto --deploy                                  # 一键全流程：导出→合并→周报→月报并部署

Old entries like python tools/summarize/daily_summary.py are still available (compatibility shim), but the new format above is recommended.

Optional: Use bash scripts/serve_local_llm.sh to create a summarize-tuned Ollama variant and import it into environment variables:

eval "$(bash scripts/serve_local_llm.sh env)"

2. Research — Paper Discovery and Researcher Analysis#

python tools/research/research_scout.py report --project my-project        # 全流程：搜索→三阶段评估→报告
python tools/research/research_scout.py ask "找 Pieter Abbeel 最近的机器人操作论文"  # 自然语言搜索（自动路由数据源）
python tools/research/research_scout.py profile "Sergey Levine"            # 研究者画像
python tools/research/research_scout.py citations 2301.12597               # 引用图谱（arXiv ID / DOI）
python tools/research/research_scout.py deploy                             # 部署报告到 Hugo

All LLM features also support --api ollama|claude_cli|anthropic|openai; use --insight for deep insights.

3. Benchmark — Performance Benchmarking#

Note: All commands must first be cd tools/benchmark/.

cd tools/benchmark
python -m benchmark.cli                    # 运行全部基准（结果追加到 CSV）
python -m benchmark.cli --cpu-only         # 只测 CPU
python -m benchmark.cli --gpu-only         # 只测 GPU
python -m benchmark.cli --report           # 测试 + 生成 HTML 报告
python -m benchmark.cli --report --deploy  # 生成报告 + 发布到 Hugo /benchmark/

GPU automatically detects CUDA / Apple MPS / Intel XPU (OpenCL only appears in --info detection).

4. Website — Hugo Blog#

pip install -e ".[website]"                          # 安装依赖（含翻译所需 torch + transformers）

# macOS/Linux：增量压缩 + Hugo 构建 + 推送 Pages
cd tools/website && bash update.sh

# Windows（脚本会自动 cd 到自己的目录）
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tools/website/update.ps1

# 本地预览（含草稿）
cd tools/website && hugo server -D

Note: Do not commit directly to tools/website/public/ (it is an independently deployed repository, automatically committed and pushed by build scripts); do not git add automatically generated content, deployment/theme repositories.

5. Translator — Document Translator#

pip install -e ".[translator]"   # 安装依赖（gradio + GGUF 翻译栈）
python -m translator             # 启动 Gradio GUI（浏览器打开）

Source language can be set to auto (detected by CJK text ratio); when the target language is auto, it automatically flips between Chinese and English. Models can be overridden via GADGET_TRANSLATION_MODEL or model management within the GUI.

6. Data Synchronization#

python scripts/sync.py push    # 推送
python scripts/sync.py pull    # 拉取

Also supports status / bootstrap / config operations, covering summarize / website / research / benchmark / backups categories, as well as the special dag category (generates and deploys DAG sites, depending on the sibling repository ai-companion).

V. Output and Precautions#

All generated artifacts are unified under outputs/ (gitignored, can be rebuilt): logs/ (intermediate products), reports/ (final reports), cache/ (LLM/search cache), data/ (structured data), images/ (charts), and backups/ (forced override backups). Hugo site content is written directly to tools/website/content|static, with no separate staging directory.

Key Taboos: Do not commit tokens/ content; do not git add automatically generated content, rclone sync data, build artifacts (build/, gadget.egg-info/), or deployment/theme repositories under tools/website/.

For more detailed step-by-step operations, data formats, and FAQ, see TUTORIAL.md in the repository and the source documents in each tool’s directory.

fable-5.1 — 8,881 chars · 16/16 facts

The project summary and usage tutorial are provided below, all content is based solely on the README.

I. Project Summary#

What is Gadgets

Gadgets (repository name gadget) is a collection of practical tools accumulated by the author during daily development, covering five directions: AI chat daily report generation, paper discovery, performance benchmarking, blog automation, and document translation. Each directory under tools/ is an independently usable tool, with common capabilities concentrated in the common/ package in the repository root (installed via pip install -e .), providing general functions such as LLM calls, JSON parsing, disk caching, atomic writes, translation, Hugo deployment, etc. The license is GPL-3.

Repository Structure

Path Role
tools/summarize/ AI Chat Daily / Weekly / Monthly Reports
tools/research/ Paper Discovery + Researcher Analysis + Citation Maps
tools/benchmark/ CPU/GPU Performance Benchmarking
tools/website/ Hugo Blog (Incremental media compression + automatic build and publish)
tools/translator/ Gradio Document Translator
common/ Shared Infrastructure Package (LLM / Cache / IO / Translation / Hugo), all tools depend on it
scripts/ Operations and Maintenance Scripts (sync.py, onboard.py, language.py, profile_translation.py, etc.)
docs/ Design Documents, ECL Plans (docs/ecl/), Audit Reports, Historical Archives (docs/archive/)
outputs/ All generated artifacts (gitignored, can be automatically rebuilt)
AGENTS.md Workflow protocols for all AI agents
CLAUDE.md Repository guide for Claude Code
pyproject.toml common/ and packaging configurations for each tool

There is also a sibling independent repository ../ai-companion/ that provides DAG publishing tools and development workflows / skills; this repository does not depend on its interception hooks.

What Each Tool Does

  • Summarize: Reads chat records from Claude Code / Codex / Cursor Agent / ChatGPT / general JSON, and calls LLMs to generate structured daily, weekly, and monthly reports. It uses a two-stage architecture for multiple devices: each device first exports data, which is then synchronized via cloud drives or manually copied for aggregation and merging. It utilizes ccusage 20.x to automatically count token usage and costs for various agent CLIs.
  • Research: A single entry point tools/research/research_scout.py with four capabilities: Paper Discovery (arXiv / bioRxiv / PubMed, a three-stage LLM pipeline that generates weekly reports and deploys them to Hugo), Deep Paper Insights (--insight, downloads full texts to analyze writing structures and automatically matches OpenReview reviews), Researcher Profiling (ArXiv + Semantic Scholar, discovering research trajectories, tier scores, and mentor-student relationships), and Citation Map Analysis.
  • Benchmark: Cross-platform CPU/GPU FLOPS testing, supporting NVIDIA CUDA, Apple MPS, and Intel XPU, with precision covering FP64 / FP32 / FP16 / BF16 / FP8 (experimental). It includes Warm-up + Formal Measurement + Statistical Analysis (median, IQR for outlier removal). Results are written to CSV in append mode, and it can generate Plotly interactive HTML reports and leaderboards, supporting deployment to Hugo and submission to public leaderboards.
  • Website: A Hugo static blog “TzJ’s Net” (PaperMod theme), deployed to GitHub Pages. It features built-in incremental image/video compression (pngquant, HandBrakeCLI, compressing only media that changed after .last_build) and local model bilingual translation. Automatically generated content from other tools is written directly to tools/website/content|static with a gadget_generated marker, so handwritten files will not be overwritten. tools/website/public/ is an independently deployed repository that is automatically committed and pushed by build scripts; do not commit manually.
  • Translator: A Gradio-based local translation web interface based on the common translation engine, supporting text and .md / .txt / .pdf / .docx / image files, while preserving Markdown formatting (code blocks, URLs, and Hugo shortcodes are protected). It performs pure local inference, automatically selecting backends (ollama / transformers / vllm / llamacpp), with models resident in memory. The default model is tencent/Hy-MT2-1.8B. The source language can be set to auto (detected by CJK ratio), and when the target is auto, it flips between Chinese and English.

Scripts in scripts/- sync.py: Centralized data synchronization based on rclone (push / pull / status / bootstrap / config), covering summarize / website / research / benchmark / backups categories; an additional dag category is used for generating and deploying DAG sites.

  • onboard.py: One-time configuration for new machines; run once after filling in tokens/onboard.yaml to automatically complete SSH, Claude/Codex CLI installation and authentication, pip extras, various tool configurations, and rclone bootstrap.
  • smoke.sh: Read-only smoke tests (--help / --info / import), which do not call LLMs, do not connect to the internet, and do not write files.
  • serve_local_llm.sh: Creates a specialized Ollama variant for summarize and outputs environment variables.
  • language.py Hugo bilingual audit + summarize report renaming. profile_translation.py: GPU performance profiling for the translation engine.

II. Usage Tutorial#

1. Environment Preparation#

Basic Requirements

  • Python 3.10 or above. The README recommends using a conda environment named AI.
  • Node.js 18 or above, required only when using the optional Companion graph and DAG publishing tools.
  • For specific dependencies of each tool, see requirements.txt in their respective directories.

External Tools Prepared on Demand

  • Ollama: Both the default LLM backend and translation backend are local Ollama, using the gemma4:26b chat model by default. If you do not want to install Ollama, you can use the claude_cli backend (reuses Claude Code CLI login state, no API key required), or anthropic / openai backends (requires an API key).
  • Hugo, pngquant, HandBrakeCLI: Required for the Website tool’s building and media compression.
  • rclone: Required for cross-device data synchronization.
  • ccusage 20.x: Required for Summarize to track token usage.
  • GPU Drivers: Benchmark will automatically detect CUDA / Apple MPS / Intel XPU.

Activate environment:

conda activate AI

2. Installation#

Execute in the repository root. all contains common packages as well as extra dependencies for summarize / research / benchmark / website, but does not include translator; translator must be installed separately.

# common 包 + summarize / research / benchmark / website
pip install -e ".[all]"

# 翻译器（gradio + GGUF 翻译栈），需单独安装
pip install -e ".[translator]"

# 仅 website（含翻译用的 torch + transformers）
pip install -e ".[website]"

Installation will generate build/ and gadget.egg-info/ in the repository root; these are gitignored, do not commit them.

After installation, you can perform a read-only smoke test to confirm that all tools can be imported and --help is available:

bash scripts/smoke.sh

3. Configuration#

Main Configuration File

Tool settings are located in config.json at the repository root (already gitignored); copy from the example:

cp config.example.json config.json

The environment variable GADGET_CONFIG can be used to override the configuration file path. sync.py reads the sync section within it, and the persistence parameters for serve_local_llm.sh are placed in the summarize section.

Secrets Directory

The tokens/ directory stores API keys and the new machine configuration table tokens/onboard.yaml; it is gitignored, do not commit its contents.

LLM Backend Selection

All LLM functions are switched via the --api parameter. Optional values: ollama (default), claude_cli, anthropic, openai. It can also be set globally via the environment variable GADGET_LLM_BACKEND.

Translation Backend Selection

Set via GADGET_TRANSLATION_BACKEND: ollama (default, reuses local gemma4:26b), llamacpp, vllm, transformers (the latter three are in-process inference using tencent/Hy-MT2-1.8B, which is automatically downloaded upon first run). The translation model can be overridden by GADGET_TRANSLATION_MODEL.

Local Ollama Variant (Optional, for Summarize)

eval "$(bash scripts/serve_local_llm.sh env)"

One-time Configuration for New Machines (Optional)

Run once after filling in tokens/onboard.yaml:

python scripts/onboard.py

The server-level system installation script has been migrated to the ai-companion repository; see usage here:

bash ../ai-companion/scripts/onboard-server.sh --help

4. Summarize: AI Daily / Weekly / Monthly Reports#

The workflow is divided into two stages. Stage one exports conversation logs on each device; stage two synchronizes and merges them daily on a summary device to generate daily reports. Once enough daily reports have accumulated, weekly and monthly reports can be generated. Adding --deploy will simultaneously deploy them to the Hugo blog.

# 阶段 1：导出所有尚未导出的日期（在每台设备上执行）
python -m summarize daily export

# 阶段 2：同步所有日期并逐日合并生成日报
python -m summarize daily merge --sync-all

# 生成 2026 年第 12 周周报并部署
python -m summarize weekly generate --week 2026-W12 --deploy

# 生成 2026 年 2 月月报并部署
python -m summarize monthly generate --month 2026-02 --deploy

# 一键全流程：导出 → 合并 → 周报 → 月报 + 部署
python -m summarize auto --deploy

Example of switching LLM backends (--api is the unified parameter):

python -m summarize auto --deploy --api claude_cli

The old entry points python tools/summarize/daily_summary.py ..., weekly_summary.py, and monthly_summary.py are still available, but using the python -m summarize format above is recommended.

Data synchronization between multiple devices uses rclone:

python scripts/sync.py push
python scripts/sync.py pull

5. Research: Paper Discovery and Researcher Analysis#

The unified entry point is tools/research/research_scout.py, run in the repository root.

# 完整流水线：搜索 → 三阶段评估 → 生成研究周报（按项目名）
python tools/research/research_scout.py report --project my-project

# 自然语言搜索，自动路由到合适的数据源
python tools/research/research_scout.py ask "找 Pieter Abbeel 最近的机器人操作论文"

# 研究者画像（论文、引用、研究轨迹、tier 分数、师生关系）
python tools/research/research_scout.py profile "Sergey Levine"

# 引用图谱分析，参数为 arXiv ID 或 DOI
python tools/research/research_scout.py citations 2301.12597

# 将报告部署到 Hugo 博客
python tools/research/research_scout.py deploy

Deep paper insights are enabled via --insight, which downloads full paper texts, analyzes writing structures and publication strategies, matches OpenReview reviews, and synthesizes them into cross-paper writing guides. The README only provides the parameter name without a complete example command; please refer to tools/research/TUTORIAL.md for specific combinations.

All LLM functions also support switching backends via --api:

python tools/research/research_scout.py profile "Sergey Levine" --api anthropic

6. Benchmark: Performance Benchmarking#

All commands must first enter the tools/benchmark/ directory. Results are written to CSV in append mode; results from multiple runs and multiple hardware setups will naturally accumulate into a leaderboard.

cd tools/benchmark

# 运行全部基准测试（结果追加到 CSV）
python -m benchmark.cli

# 只测 CPU
python -m benchmark.cli --cpu-only

# 只测 GPU
python -m benchmark.cli --gpu-only

# 运行测试并生成 HTML 报告
python -m benchmark.cli --report

# 生成报告并发布到 Hugo 站点的 /benchmark/ 路径
python -m benchmark.cli --report --deploy

GPU type is automatically detected (CUDA / MPS / XPU) without needing manual specification. --info can be used to detect hardware information; OpenCL devices will only appear in detection results and will not actually run tests.

7. Website: Hugo Blog#

First, install the website dependencies:

pip install -e ".[website]"

Local preview (development server, including drafts):

cd tools/website && hugo server -D

One-click incremental media compression, translation, Hugo build, and push to GitHub Pages:

# macOS / Linux
cd tools/website && bash update.sh

# Windows（脚本会自行切换到所在目录）
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tools/website/update.ps1

Notes:

  • Only compresses images (pngquant) and videos (HandBrakeCLI) that have changed after .last_build.
  • Translation is completed locally, defaulting to Ollama, falling back to vLLM on Linux and transformers on Windows; the model tencent/Hy-MT2-1.8B is automatically downloaded upon first run.
  • The --deploy of other tools will write generated content to tools/website/content|static and mark it with gadget_generated; handwritten files without this mark will not be overwritten.
  • tools/website/public/ is an independent deployment repository, automatically committed and pushed by scripts; do not commit manually, and do not git add the deployment or theme repositories under it.

8. Translator: Gradio Document Translator#

Install and start; the interface will automatically open in your browser after starting:

pip install -e ".[translator]"
python -m translator

Usage points:

  • Supports direct text input or uploading .md / .txt / .pdf / .docx / image files, preserving Markdown format during translation.
  • Source language is optional (auto), automatically determined by the proportion of CJK characters in the text; when the target language is auto, it automatically flips between Chinese and English.
  • Automatic backend selection: prioritizes ollama if the model tag has been pulled, falls back to transformers on Windows, prioritizes vllm on Linux, and offers llamacpp (GGUF) for low VRAM.
  • Default model is tencent/Hy-MT2-1.8B (GGUF version is tencent/Hy-MT2-1.8B-GGUF); automatically downloaded upon first use. You can change it via the environment variable GADGET_TRANSLATION_MODEL or through model management in the interface; models are lazy-loaded as needed when switching.

9. Data Synchronization and Output Directories#

Synchronization

scripts/sync.py supports push / pull / status / bootstrap / config operations, covering summarize / website / research / benchmark / backups categories; rclone must be configured first. The command format provided in the README is:

python scripts/sync.py
python scripts/sync.py push
python scripts/sync.py pull
python scripts/sync.py --category dag     # 生成并部署 DAG 站点，依赖 ../ai-companion/

Output Directories

All generated files are unified in outputs/, which is gitignored and can be automatically rebuilt:

Subdirectory Content
logs/ Intermediate products such as export logs, runtime logs, etc.
reports/ Final reports (Markdown, JSON, HTML)
cache/ LLM cache, search cache
data/ Structured data (CSV, JSON images)
images/ Charts and generated images
backups/ Backups before forced overwrite

Hugo site content is written directly to tools/website/content|static, with no separate outputs/site staging directory.

10. Summary of Precautions- Do not submit tokens/、outputs/、build/、gadget.egg-info/, rclone data synchronization, as well as the deployment repositories and theme repositories under tools/website/.#

  • config.json has been gitignored; new machines need to be copied from config.example.json.
  • Modify tool logic in tools/<tool>/, modify shared capabilities in common/, modify synchronization in scripts/sync.py, and development workflows and skills are in the ai-companion repository.
  • For more detailed steps, data formats, and FAQ, see TUTORIAL.md within the repository and the documentation under each tool directory.
